misc-byron-buxton-season-ending-hip-surg.text: twins' byron buxton set for season-ending hip surgery the twins center fielder will undergo arthroscopic right-hip surgery september 18 after three injured-list stints this season. minnesota twins center fielder byron buxton will miss the rest of the season and undergo arthroscopic surgery on his right hip september 18, the team announced friday. buxton has been dealing with a hip impingement that placed him on the injured list three times this season. he last appeared for minnesota on august 25. manager derek shelton told reporters that buxton is expected to recover before the start of the 2027 season. the 32-year-old played 93 games this year, batting .254 with 25 home runs and 46 runs batted in. he also made the american league all-star team for the second consecutive season and the third time in his career. durability has repeatedly shaped buxton's career. he has reached 100 games in only three of his 12 major-league seasons, including a career-high 140 in 2017. entering friday, the twins were 69-77 and 4 1/2 games behind cleveland for the american league's third wild-card position. the surgery removes a key bat and defender from minnesota's late playoff push, but the club's timetable prioritizes a full recovery for next spring. more misc misc. mn minneapolis minneapolis, mn byron buxton minnesota twins mlb hip surgery baseball

misc-campanellas-cranston-reopening-2026.text: campanella’s in cranston plans september 16 reopening the longtime restaurant is preparing to welcome customers back after the campanella family purchased it from a court-appointed receiver. campanella’s in cranston is scheduled to reopen september 16, bringing the longtime restaurant back after a closure tied to court-supervised receivership proceedings. the campanella family purchased the restaurant from a court-appointed receiver several months ago and is preparing the dining room and kitchen for a grand reopening. the return restores a familiar local name and puts the business back under family ownership. the restaurant entered receivership after a business dispute and fraud allegations involving andrew loffredo in may. those claims are allegations, and this report does not treat them as proven. the receivership provided the legal process through which the property and operating assets could be transferred. owners announced the reopening date monday. details such as regular hours, reservations and the full opening menu may be updated closer to september 16, so customers should check the restaurant’s official channels before visiting. the confirmed development is that the family completed the purchase and has set a public date to resume service. more ri cranston, rhode island campanella's cranston restaurants rhode island

misc-celine-dion-first-full-concert-six-.text: celine dion prepares first full concert in six years the sold-out paris-area residency begins saturday and marks the singer's first complete concert program in six years. celine dion is scheduled to perform her first full concert in six years saturday, opening a sold-out residency in the paris suburb of nanterre. the return follows a long interruption caused by stiff-person syndrome, a rare neurological disorder that can produce severe muscle stiffness and spasms. dion announced her diagnosis in 2022 and largely withdrew from public performance. she made a major one-song appearance at the 2024 paris olympics opening ceremony, singing from the eiffel tower, but the new residency represents a return to a complete concert program. the 58-year-old singer is scheduled to perform 26 shows over the next eight months. fans have gathered outside dion's paris hotel during two weeks of preparations, and the city has promoted the opening with themed decorations at the venue's metro station, a merchandise pop-up and a large public karaoke event. the residency is expected to draw audiences from around the world. saturday's opening will be the clearest test yet of dion's ability to resume sustained live performance after years of treatment and rehabilitation. more misc misc. france nanterre nanterre, france celine dion paris music stiff-person syndrome concerts

misc-charlotte-rose-ilca-6-world-title-2.text: charlotte rose wins ilca 6 world title in dublin bay the american sailor finished with 23 points to become the first non-european women’s champion in the olympic dinghy class since 2006. american sailor charlotte rose won the ilca 6 women’s world championship on saturday after navigating two final races in difficult conditions on dublin bay. rose carried 15 points from qualifying and finished second and sixth in the medal-deciding series to end the regatta with 23 points. belgium’s two-time world champion emma plasschaert finished second with 28 points, while denmark’s anna munch took third with 34. rose became the first non-european to win the title in 20 years, following china’s xu lijia in 2006. the ilca 6 is the women’s single-handed dinghy class used in olympic competition. rose celebrated by deliberately capsizing her boat and jumping into the water after the result was confirmed. her consistency proved decisive in a final contested by 10 boats, where changing conditions placed a premium on minimizing poor finishes. the championship adds a major global title for u.s. sailing and gives rose a benchmark result in one of the sport’s most competitive individual classes. more misc misc. ireland dublin dublin bay, ireland charlotte rose ilca 6 sailing world championship

misc-charlotte-rose-ilca-6-worlds-lead-2.text: american charlotte rose leads women’s ilca 6 world championship rose carried a two-point lead into gold fleet racing after winning both of tuesday’s races on dublin bay. american sailor charlotte rose led the women’s ilca 6 world championship on wednesday as the 108-boat field moved into gold and silver fleet competition on dublin bay. rose entered the decisive phase two points clear after winning both races tuesday. the shift to gold fleet concentrates the strongest qualifiers in the same races, effectively tightening the contest even for sailors who built an early advantage. irish olympic prospect eve mcmahon and 2016 olympic silver medalist annalise murphy also qualified for gold fleet on home waters. their presence gives the first women’s ilca world championship staged in ireland a prominent local storyline alongside rose’s bid for the title. the regatta is scheduled to conclude saturday, when the leading 10 sailors will contest the medal series for final podium positions. standings can change with each race and may be affected by wind, course decisions or scoring rules, so rose’s wednesday lead is a tournament snapshot rather than a final result. more misc misc. international dublin dublin, ireland charlotte rose ilca 6 sailing world championship

misc-children-911-health-study-2026.excerpt: The project will seek to identify and track people who were young, infants or in utero near lower Manhattan and Brooklyn after the attacks.
misc-children-911-health-study-2026.text: cdc plans major health study of children exposed to 9/11 the project will seek to identify and track people who were young, infants or in utero near lower manhattan and brooklyn after the attacks. the centers for disease control and prevention is preparing a large study of people who were children near the world trade center when the towers fell, addressing a major gap in long-term september 11 health research. reuters reported that roughly 25,000 children lived or attended school near lower manhattan in 2001, with thousands more in surrounding neighborhoods. many encountered dust containing pulverized concrete, glass fibers, asbestos and other pollutants, yet few entered the government-funded studies that largely followed first responders and other adults. the cdc plans to seek research applications for a world trade center youth research coordinating center and a long-term cohort. eligible participants would have been 21 or younger, or in utero, and living below 14th street in manhattan or anywhere in brooklyn on and after the attacks. researchers also plan a similarly aged comparison group without the same exposure. key details, including the target number of participants, proposal date and available funding, have not been finalized publicly. scientists hope the project can clarify possible links to cancers, cardiovascular disease and reproductive outcomes as the exposed population reaches its 30s and early 40s. more misc misc. northeast new york new york, ny september 11 cdc public health new york

misc-como-champions-league-debut-leipzig.text: como wins 4-1 in dream champions league debut the italian newcomer beat rb leipzig after racing to upgrade its stadium, while manchester united and bayern munich also posted convincing wins. como marked its first champions league match with a 4-1 victory over rb leipzig, delivering the night’s standout result after a rapid effort to bring its stadium up to competition standards. the italian club entered the tournament as a newcomer and immediately converted the occasion into a decisive win. its debut added another unexpected chapter to a round that also featured strong starts from established powers. manchester united beat sabah 4-0, while bayern munich defeated bodo/glimt 5-0. bayern’s victory extended its run of winning champions league opening matches to 23 consecutive campaigns. roma and fenerbahce drew 1-1 in another of thursday’s fixtures. sabah also made history by fielding a starting lineup containing players from 11 different nationalities, according to reuters. for como, however, the scoreline supplied the clearest statement: a club that had been racing to prepare its venue looked fully ready on the field. the result gives como an early platform in the competition, though the league phase will demand sustained performances against a wider range of opponents. more misc misc. italy como como, italy como champions league soccer european football

misc-courteney-cox-evil-genius-tiff-2026.text: courteney cox returns to film directing with tiff true-crime thriller “evil genius” dramatizes the 2003 pennsylvania pizza-bomber case and stars patricia arquette and david harbour. courteney cox returned to feature-film directing after a 12-year gap with “evil genius,” a true-crime thriller that premiered saturday at the toronto international film festival. the film revisits the 2003 “pizza bomber” case in erie, pennsylvania, in which delivery driver brian wells died after being forced to rob a bank with an explosive device locked around his neck. patricia arquette plays marjorie diehl-armstrong, who was convicted in connection with the plot, while david harbour portrays her former fiancé and accomplice bill rothstein. the story centers on the pair’s destructive relationship and the chain of crimes surrounding the robbery. cox said the production aimed for a tone that could hold the case’s bizarre details, dark humor and lethal consequences without turning it into a conventional procedural. the project draws on a case previously examined in a 2018 netflix documentary series, but shifts the focus toward a dramatized account of the people behind the scheme. for cox, best known to many viewers for acting in “friends” and the “scream” franchise, the tiff premiere marks a renewed move behind the camera and puts the film before distributors and festival audiences. more misc misc. ontario toronto toronto, canada courteney cox evil genius tiff film

misc-dorchester-dog-rescue-2026.text: neighbors and firefighters rescue 17-year-old dog in dorchester milly, who is blind and deaf, wandered from her fenced yard before a neighborhood search brought her safely home about four hours later. a neighborhood search in dorchester ended with the safe return of milly, a 17-year-old dog who is blind and deaf and had wandered away from her fenced-in yard, wbur reported. milly’s family realized the gate might not have latched and began looking through ashmont hill. neighbors joined the search, and firefighters from the engine 18/ladder 6 house helped locate the dog after she had spent roughly four hours moving around the neighborhood. the rescue brought milly back to her family and offered a small reminder of how quickly a local search can become a community effort. firefighters even used steak to help coax the dog to safety. for the family, the happy ending came after an anxious afternoon and a search that crossed the ordinary boundaries of one household. the story also shows the practical value of neighbors sharing information quickly when a vulnerable animal goes missing. more misc misc. ma boston dorchester, boston, ma boston dorchester community pets rescue

misc-east-providence-pawpaw-garden-2026.text: east providence grower cultivates hundreds of pawpaw trees joe barros has spent 15 years building a backyard collection of north america’s largest native fruit and inviting neighbors to try it. an east providence backyard has become home to hundreds of pawpaw trees, part of resident joe barros’s effort to introduce more rhode islanders to a fruit that is native to north america but unfamiliar to many shoppers. nbc 10 wjar reported that barros has grown the trees for 15 years. pawpaws are considered north america’s largest native fruit, with a soft texture and tropical flavor. barros describes the taste as a blend of mango and banana. his interest began when tasting a pawpaw reminded him of childhood in brazil. what started as curiosity developed into a large backyard collection and a personal campaign to share ripe fruit with visitors who have never encountered it. pawpaws can seem out of place in new england because of their tropical character, yet the species is native to the continent. barros hopes wider interest could eventually make rhode island known for the fruit. for now, his garden is a local example of how one grower’s long-term experimentation can preserve an unusual crop and build community around harvest season. more ri east providence, rhode island east providence pawpaw gardening local food

misc-eddie-dunbar-wins-vuelta-stage-19-2.text: eddie dunbar wins vuelta stage 19 with late pass the irish rider caught santiago buitrago with 500 meters remaining while enric mas protected the overall lead. ireland’s eddie dunbar overtook santiago buitrago in the final 500 meters to win stage 19 of the vuelta a españa on friday, timing his chase at the end of a hilly day into estepona. dunbar, riding for pinarello q36.5, reeled in the colombian climber after buitrago had moved into the lead. teammate thomas gloag finished third on the 210.8-kilometer route from vélez-málaga. spanish rider enric mas retained the overall leader’s jersey and will start saturday’s penultimate stage with an advantage of one minute, 37 seconds over primoz roglic. the next test is a 186.8-kilometer mountain route from la calahorra to collado del alguacil. dunbar’s late acceleration settled the stage without changing the top of the general classification. mas now has one major mountain day left before the race reaches its final conclusion, while roglic must erase a substantial deficit if he is to take the overall lead. more misc misc. spain estepona estepona, spain eddie dunbar vuelta a espana cycling enric mas stage 19

misc-emmys-jean-smart-harrison-ford-mile.text: jean smart and harrison ford approach emmy milestones smart could complete a five-season awards sweep for hacks, while ford is seeking the first emmy of his career for shrinking. jean smart and harrison ford enter monday’s emmy awards with the chance to reach distinct career milestones as the television industry gathers in los angeles. smart could become the first performer to win best comedy actress in every season of a show’s run if she earns a fifth award for hacks. ford, 84, is nominated for shrinking and is seeking the first emmy of his career despite decades of film and television work. the pitt is favored in the best-drama race for a second consecutive year, and its star noah wyle is also contending for a second straight acting award. mariska hargitay will host the ceremony, scheduled for 8 p.m. eastern on nbc and peacock. michael j. fox is set to receive a humanitarian honor. the celebration arrives while hollywood faces production cutbacks, consolidation and anxiety over artificial intelligence. paramount skydance’s proposed warner bros. discovery deal is among the business shifts hanging over the industry. the awards will recognize the past television season even as studios, workers and audiences navigate a rapidly changing market. more misc misc. california los angeles los angeles, ca emmy awards jean smart harrison ford television

misc-emmys-pitt-hacks-2026-preview-2026-.text: the pitt, hacks headline emmy race ahead of monday night ceremony the 78th primetime emmy awards will air monday night with the pitt defending its drama presence and hacks’ jean smart chasing another comedy-acting win. television’s biggest awards race reaches its ceremony monday night, with the pitt and hacks among the programs drawing attention at the 78th primetime emmy awards in los angeles. the pitt is competing for best drama for the second consecutive year. the medical series is part of a field that includes established television franchises and newer streaming hits, as voters weigh the season’s most widely recognized performances. hacks star jean smart could win comedy actress for another season, while harrison ford is in contention for his first emmy at age 84. the report also identified the limited series widow’s bay as a late entrant attracting momentum. the ceremony is scheduled for 8 p.m. eastern on nbc and peacock, with mariska hargitay as host. more than 27,000 television academy members vote on the awards, so the preview reflects the competitive field rather than final results. the report remains subject to further verified updates as officials continue reviewing the circumstances. more more misc. california los angeles los angeles, california misc. television emmy awards

misc-england-pakistan-test-sweep-root-20.excerpt: Unbeaten half-centuries from Joe Root and Jordan Cox completed an eight-wicket win at Edgbaston and England’s first Test-series victory in 19 months.
misc-england-pakistan-test-sweep-root-20.text: root guides england to 3-0 test sweep of pakistan unbeaten half-centuries from joe root and jordan cox completed an eight-wicket win at edgbaston and england’s first test-series victory in 19 months. england completed a 3-0 test-series sweep of pakistan with an eight-wicket victory at edgbaston, reaching a target of 130 behind unbeaten half-centuries from captain joe root and jordan cox. root finished on 62 and cox on 59 as the hosts closed out the final match after an early wobble in the chase. pakistan briefly created pressure with two quick wickets and nearly dismissed root when he was bowled on a delivery ruled a no-ball. root and cox then settled the innings and carried england to the result without another loss. pakistan had forced england to bat again after a resilient second innings led by debutant razaullah, who struck 81 from the lower order. the sweep gave england its first test-series victory in 19 months and a successful return to captaincy for root following ben stokes’ retirement. england’s bowlers had controlled much of the series, with ollie robinson taking 21 wickets. the result offers momentum before a more demanding tour of south africa, while pakistan leaves the series looking for greater stability after personnel and coaching changes during a difficult run of results. more misc misc. england birmingham birmingham, england cricket england pakistan joe root test series

misc-frances-tiafoe-us-open-semifinal-co.excerpt: The American recovered from two sets and a break down to beat Alex Michelsen and earn a semifinal meeting with Ben Shelton.
misc-frances-tiafoe-us-open-semifinal-co.text: frances tiafoe completes comeback to reach u.s. open semifinals the american recovered from two sets and a break down to beat alex michelsen and earn a semifinal meeting with ben shelton. frances tiafoe reached the u.s. open semifinals for the third time after rallying from two sets and a break down against fellow american alex michelsen. the 11th seed won 5-7, 3-6, 7-5, 6-3, 7-6(6) on tuesday at arthur ashe stadium, reuters reported. michelsen served for the match in the third set, but tiafoe broke back and shifted the momentum. the victory set up an all-american semifinal against ben shelton, who later defeated defending champion carlos alcaraz. it guarantees a u.s. player a place in the men’s final. tiafoe also reached the tournament’s semifinals in 2022 and 2024. his latest run keeps alive the effort to end a long drought in american men’s major singles tennis: andy roddick remains the last u.s. man to win a grand slam title, at the 2003 u.s. open. the semifinal matchup is now fixed, but its schedule and any later tournament details should be confirmed with organizers. more misc misc. ny new york new york, new york frances tiafoe alex michelsen u.s. open tennis

misc-french-alps-2030-chief-expected-to-.excerpt: The committee’s board is expected to formalize Edgar Grospiron’s departure amid a wider leadership shake-up.
misc-french-alps-2030-chief-expected-to-.text: french alps 2030 organizing chief expected to leave, source says the committee’s board is expected to formalize edgar grospiron’s departure amid a wider leadership shake-up. edgar grospiron, president of the organizing committee for the 2030 winter olympic and paralympic games in the french alps, is expected to leave the post, a source familiar with the situation told reuters on wednesday. the committee’s executive board is expected to formalize the departure, while exit terms are still being negotiated. national and regional authorities and french olympic organizations told the international olympic committee in august that confidence in grospiron’s leadership had broken down, reuters reported. the expected move follows a broader period of turnover. director general cyril linette resigned after disagreements with grospiron, and other senior operations and communications officials have also left. venue planning has added pressure: ice events were shifted from nice to lyon after the city rejected a proposal to adapt its stadium for men’s hockey, while speed skating is planned for heerenveen in the netherlands. the departure was not yet final at publication, so the committee’s formal decision and succession plan remain the next confirmed steps. leadership stability will be important as organizers move from early governance and venue decisions toward detailed delivery schedules for the 2030 games. more misc misc. international paris paris, france 2030 winter olympics french alps edgar grospiron sports governance

misc-generation-remembers-911-as-history.excerpt: Reuters gathered accounts from people too young to remember the attacks about how schools, families and later events shaped their understanding.
misc-generation-remembers-911-as-history.text: a generation understands september 11 as history, not memory reuters gathered accounts from people too young to remember the attacks about how schools, families and later events shaped their understanding. twenty-five years after the september 11 attacks, a full generation has grown up without a personal memory of the day, learning about it through relatives, classrooms, online archives and the wars that followed. reuters collected accounts from people born around or after 2001 in the united states and other countries. their experiences show how an event shifts from lived memory to history while continuing to influence ideas about national security, american power and public grief. for some, the first explanation came from parents who described where they were. others encountered the attacks through school lessons or images online. the nearly 3,000 deaths remain central to commemoration, but younger people also place the day within a longer story that includes military conflicts and changes in travel and surveillance. the transition creates a challenge for educators and museums: preserve factual detail and individual experiences without assuming students remember the atmosphere of 2001. the 25th anniversary makes that task more visible as commemorations increasingly bring together witnesses, survivors and adults for whom september 11 has always been a historical event. more misc misc. northeast new york new york, ny september 11 new york history education

misc-grand-slam-player-advisory-council-.excerpt: Players seeking a greater role in tournament decisions and a larger share of revenues will pursue negotiations through a new council.
misc-grand-slam-player-advisory-council-.text: tennis players move pay campaign into new grand slam advisory council players seeking a greater role in tournament decisions and a larger share of revenues will pursue negotiations through a new council. top tennis players are moving their campaign for greater influence and improved financial terms into a new player advisory council that will negotiate with the four grand slam tournaments, reuters reported monday. the campaign began in 2025 with demands for a stronger player voice in grand slam decision-making, increased welfare funding and a proposal for players to receive 22% of tournament revenues as prize money by 2030. players increased pressure this year by cutting short media obligations at the french open and wimbledon. the tournaments responded with larger prize pools, including a record $108 million at the u.s. open, according to reuters. the group said the new council will allow players to work directly with tournament organizers on an ongoing basis. the u.s. open has also committed $2 million toward player welfare, a move the players welcomed while saying more goals remain unresolved. players said they reserve the right to restart public action if the council does not produce meaningful progress. for now, the new structure shifts the dispute from tournament-week protests toward formal negotiations. more more misc. united states new york new york sports tennis grand slam players association

misc-gruffalo-granny-new-story-release-2.excerpt: Julia Donaldson and Axel Scheffler return with “Gruffalo Granny,” extending the children’s series after two decades without a new installment.
misc-gruffalo-granny-new-story-release-2.text: first new gruffalo story in more than 20 years reaches shelves julia donaldson and axel scheffler return with “gruffalo granny,” extending the children’s series after two decades without a new installment. a new gruffalo book has arrived for the first time in more than 20 years. “gruffalo granny,” released thursday, reunites writer julia donaldson and illustrator axel scheffler for another story in the children’s series that began with “the gruffalo.” the book follows the gruffalo and his daughter as they prepare for a visit from granny. it extends a fictional world that has remained widely read even without frequent sequels. the series has sold more than 18.2 million copies, while the original book has been translated into 113 languages and dialects, according to reuters. donaldson and scheffler reflected on their long collaboration as they introduced the installment. their combination of rhythmic storytelling and distinctive illustrations has carried the character from picture books into stage productions, screen adaptations and family attractions. the creators did not announce another book, but they also left open the possibility of returning to the characters again. for now, “gruffalo granny” is the first expansion of the main story line in a generation, giving longtime readers a new chapter to share with children discovering the forest characters for the first time. the publication’s reception will show whether the series’ long gap has increased demand for further stories. more misc misc. united kingdom london london, united kingdom gruffalo granny julia donaldson axel scheffler children's books

misc-hamilton-bearman-crash-spanish-gp-p.excerpt: The two crashes interrupted the final session at the new Madring circuit, where Kimi Antonelli set the fastest practice time.
misc-hamilton-bearman-crash-spanish-gp-p.text: hamilton and bearman crash as antonelli leads spanish gp practice the two crashes interrupted the final session at the new madring circuit, where kimi antonelli set the fastest practice time. lewis hamilton and oliver bearman both crashed during final practice for formula one’s spanish grand prix at madrid’s new madring circuit, interrupting the last track session before saturday qualifying. mercedes driver kimi antonelli finished fastest, with ferrari’s charles leclerc next on the timing sheet. hamilton locked his ferrari at the final corner and hit the barriers with a little more than half an hour remaining. he initially tried to drive the damaged car toward the pits with its front wing trapped underneath and a punctured right-front tire, then stopped after repeated instructions from the team. the session was red-flagged while crews repaired the barrier. bearman later brought another stoppage when he crashed his haas near the end. the incidents added uncertainty before qualifying on a layout where close walls and higher speeds leave little margin for error. drivers have also said overtaking may be difficult, increasing the importance of grid position for sunday’s race. antonelli’s pace gave mercedes a strong final-practice marker, but the disrupted session limited representative running for several teams as they prepared their qualifying setups. more misc misc. spain madrid madrid, spain formula one lewis hamilton kimi antonelli spanish grand prix madring

misc-harrison-skupski-us-open-doubles-20.excerpt: The American-British pair beat Kevin Krawietz and Tim Puetz in straight sets for its second major title of 2026.
misc-harrison-skupski-us-open-doubles-20.text: harrison and skupski win u.s. open men’s doubles title the american-british pair beat kevin krawietz and tim puetz in straight sets for its second major title of 2026. christian harrison and neal skupski won the u.s. open men’s doubles championship on saturday, defeating germany’s kevin krawietz and tim puetz 6-4, 7-6 (6). the title gave the american-british partnership its second grand slam trophy of the season after winning the australian open. harrison and skupski controlled the opening set, then closed a tighter second set in a tiebreak. their ability to finish in straight sets limited the opportunity for krawietz and puetz to force a deciding third set on the new york hard courts. the victory completes a notable two-major season for a pairing that has translated complementary serving and net play into results on different surfaces and continents. grand slam doubles matches often turn on a small number of return points and quick exchanges, making the second-set tiebreak the decisive pressure moment. harrison and skupski handled it to secure the championship without extending the match. the result also places them among the season’s most successful men’s doubles teams, with major titles at both the first and final grand slam events of 2026. more misc misc. united states new york new york, united states u.s. open christian harrison neal skupski tennis

misc-hawksmoor-boston-fort-point-opening.excerpt: The London-born steakhouse has opened on Necco Street with a Boston-specific menu alongside its signature dry-aged steaks.
misc-hawksmoor-boston-fort-point-opening.text: hawksmoor opens third u.s. restaurant in boston’s fort point the london-born steakhouse has opened on necco street with a boston-specific menu alongside its signature dry-aged steaks. london-based steakhouse hawksmoor has opened a boston location in fort point, giving the restaurant group its third u.s. outpost. the new restaurant is on necco street and is led in the kitchen by boston head chef thomas park, according to axios boston. its core menu centers on dry-aged cuts, including porterhouse and rib chop sourced from châtel farms in georgia. the boston location also adds references to the city’s food culture. axios reported a pistachio espresso martini inspired by caffè vittoria and cream-filled chocolates offered in several flavors. those details are intended to distinguish the restaurant from the company’s other u.s. locations rather than simply duplicate the london menu. the opening adds another high-end dining option to fort point, a neighborhood where offices, housing and restaurants share former industrial blocks near the seaport. menu availability and prices can change after opening, so diners should check the restaurant’s current information before visiting. the launch is notable locally as another international hospitality brand tests a boston-specific format. more misc misc. ma boston boston, massachusetts boston fort point restaurants hawksmoor

misc-infantino-opponents-governance-refo.excerpt: Reuters sources say the FIFA president retains enough association support to survive the challenge, pushing critics to focus on checks on executive power.
misc-infantino-opponents-governance-refo.text: infantino opponents shift toward fifa governance reform as challenge falters reuters sources say the fifa president retains enough association support to survive the challenge, pushing critics to focus on checks on executive power. fifa president gianni infantino appears to have enough support to win reelection next year, prompting opponents to shift their attention toward reducing presidential power and strengthening governance controls, according to reuters interviews with people familiar with the discussions. infantino faced the most serious challenge of his decade in office after a proposal to sell a 20% stake in fifa competitions collapsed in july. uefa, the asian football confederation and concacaf opposed the plan, while several european national federations withdrew their support. reuters reported that infantino retains strong relationships with many smaller national associations and support across oceania, africa and south america. no viable challenger has emerged before the november 18 nomination deadline, and potential candidates cited in football circles have declined to run. opponents are therefore considering a campaign for structural changes, including greater transparency and stronger checks on major commercial decisions. infantino is seeking another term in the march 18, 2027, election in rabat. the assessment of his support is based on reuters sourcing rather than a completed vote; national associations will make the formal decision at the election. more misc misc. switzerland zurich global soccer fifa gianni infantino soccer governance

misc-ingebrigtsen-withdraws-1500-kerr-20.excerpt: The Norwegian runner cited recovery demands after winning Friday’s 5,000 meters during his return from Achilles surgery.
misc-ingebrigtsen-withdraws-1500-kerr-20.text: ingebrigtsen withdraws from 1,500 meters, delaying kerr showdown the norwegian runner cited recovery demands after winning friday’s 5,000 meters during his return from achilles surgery. jakob ingebrigtsen withdrew from sunday’s 1,500-meter race at the ultimate championship, postponing another anticipated meeting with british rival josh kerr. the norwegian runner had won the 5,000 meters on friday but decided against racing twice within three days as he continues his recovery from achilles surgery. ingebrigtsen underwent the operation in february and returned to competition last month after nearly a year away. his friday victory showed that he could again handle championship-level racing, but the shorter turnaround presented a different recovery demand. the withdrawal leaves the 1,500 without one of its highest-profile entrants. the decision also delays a rivalry that has become one of middle-distance running’s central storylines. ingebrigtsen and kerr have not raced each other since 2024, and their tactical contrast makes each scheduled meeting a major event. for ingebrigtsen, the choice prioritizes a controlled return over adding another race immediately after the 5,000. kerr remains in the field, while the norwegian’s next chance to test himself over 1,500 meters will depend on his recovery and schedule. more misc misc. hungary budapest budapest, hungary jakob ingebrigtsen josh kerr 1500 meters ultimate championship

misc-james-rodriguez-atletico-nacional-2.excerpt: The 35-year-old midfielder signed through June 2027, beginning his first spell in Colombia since leaving the country as a teenager.
misc-james-rodriguez-atletico-nacional-2.text: james rodriguez returns to colombia with atletico nacional the 35-year-old midfielder signed through june 2027, beginning his first spell in colombia since leaving the country as a teenager. james rodriguez has returned to colombian club soccer, signing with atletico nacional on a free transfer through june 30, 2027. reuters reported that the move is the 35-year-old midfielder’s first professional spell in his home country since he left as a teenager. rodriguez most recently played for minnesota united in major league soccer. his career has taken him to 14 clubs in 12 countries, including real madrid, bayern munich, porto and everton. atletico nacional adds a globally recognized playmaker with extensive experience in domestic leagues, continental competitions and international tournaments. the midfielder became an international star at the 2014 world cup, winning the golden boot as the tournament’s leading scorer. real madrid subsequently signed him for 75 million euros. across his club career he has collected 25 trophies, and he has made 131 appearances for colombia. the transfer brings rodriguez back to a league where he developed before beginning his overseas career with argentina’s banfield in 2008. atletico nacional will now need to integrate his creativity and experience while managing the physical demands on a veteran player approaching the later stage of his career. more misc misc. colombia medellin medellin, colombia james rodriguez atletico nacional colombia soccer transfer

misc-jessica-pegula-third-straight-us-op.excerpt: Pegula rallied past Emma Navarro in three sets to earn a semifinal rematch with two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka.
misc-jessica-pegula-third-straight-us-op.text: jessica pegula reaches third straight u.s. open semifinal pegula rallied past emma navarro in three sets to earn a semifinal rematch with two-time defending champion aryna sabalenka. jessica pegula reached the u.s. open semifinals for a third consecutive year after rallying from a set down to defeat fellow american emma navarro. pegula won 3-6, 6-4, 6-3 tuesday at arthur ashe stadium. the 32-year-old recovered from an error-filled opening set, improved enough to level the match and used an extra service break to control the deciding set. the victory was pegula’s fifth in a row over navarro, including their meeting at the cincinnati open last month. it also marked pegula’s 50th win of the season, making her the first player on the women’s tour to reach that total in 2026. pegula will next face two-time defending champion aryna sabalenka in a rematch of the 2024 u.s. open final. reaching the final would require pegula to reverse that previous result against the world’s top-ranked player. match timing and later tournament details remain subject to the official u.s. open schedule. more misc misc. ny new york new york city, new york jessica pegula u.s. open emma navarro tennis

misc-john-klingberg-retires-700-nhl-game.excerpt: The Swedish defenseman ends a career that included 443 regular-season points, an All-Star selection and two trips to the Stanley Cup Final.
misc-john-klingberg-retires-700-nhl-game.text: john klingberg retires after 700 nhl games the swedish defenseman ends a career that included 443 regular-season points, an all-star selection and two trips to the stanley cup final. swedish defenseman john klingberg announced his retirement friday after 700 nhl regular-season games across six teams. klingberg, 34, spent his first eight nhl seasons with the dallas stars after the club selected him in the fifth round of the 2010 draft. he earned all-rookie recognition in 2014-15 and was selected for the all-star game in 2017-18. he finished with 443 regular-season points, including 92 goals and 351 assists, during stops with dallas, anaheim, minnesota, toronto, edmonton and san jose. last season he recorded 27 points in 56 games for the sharks. klingberg also produced 43 points in 82 playoff games. his postseason career included stanley cup final appearances with dallas in 2020 and edmonton in 2025. both series ended in six-game losses. internationally, klingberg helped sweden win consecutive world championship gold medals in 2017 and 2018, adding major national-team success to a long 12-season nhl career as a mobile defenseman. more misc misc. sweden sweden john klingberg nhl retirement dallas stars sweden

misc-lando-norris-spanish-gp-pole-madrin.excerpt: The McLaren driver edged Kimi Antonelli by 0.011 seconds with a late qualifying lap at Formula One’s new Madrid circuit.
misc-lando-norris-spanish-gp-pole-madrin.text: lando norris takes spanish grand prix pole at madring the mclaren driver edged kimi antonelli by 0.011 seconds with a late qualifying lap at formula one’s new madrid circuit. lando norris secured pole position for the spanish grand prix on saturday with a late lap at madrid’s new madring circuit. the mclaren driver recorded 1 minute, 31.824 seconds and beat mercedes driver kimi antonelli by 0.011 seconds. norris sat sixth before his final attempt but found enough speed despite acknowledging a small error at the last corner. the result delivered the 19th pole of his formula one career and his third of the 2026 season. max verstappen qualified third for red bull, while lewis hamilton placed fourth. starting position could carry extra weight at a circuit where drivers and teams expect overtaking to be difficult. the narrow qualifying margin also leaves little separation among the leading cars before sunday’s race. madring is hosting formula one for the first time, adding an unfamiliar layout to the normal challenge of managing tires, strategy and traffic. norris now has the best starting spot, but antonelli and verstappen will begin close enough to apply immediate pressure. more misc misc. spain madrid madrid, spain lando norris spanish grand prix formula one madring

misc-lil-durk-acquitted-murder-for-hire-.excerpt: The Grammy-winning rapper was cleared of all charges in the Los Angeles case but remains jailed ahead of a separate October trial.
misc-lil-durk-acquitted-murder-for-hire-.text: lil durk acquitted in federal murder-for-hire trial the grammy-winning rapper was cleared of all charges in the los angeles case but remains jailed ahead of a separate october trial. grammy-winning rapper lil durk was acquitted friday of all charges in a federal murder-for-hire trial in los angeles. the artist, whose legal name is durk banks, had been accused of ordering and financing a 2022 ambush intended to kill rival rapper quando rondo. the shooting instead killed rondo’s cousin, saviay’a robinson, near the beverly center. prosecutors alleged that banks sought retaliation for the 2020 killing of his friend and fellow rapper king von. defense lawyers argued that a former personal assistant arranged the plot without banks’ knowledge. that former assistant and two other associates reached plea agreements and testified for the prosecution, according to the los angeles city news service account cited by reuters. two co-defendants tried with banks were also acquitted of the central murder-for-hire charges but convicted of conspiracy to commit stalking and related stalking counts. banks remains in custody despite friday’s verdict because he faces a separate trial scheduled for october 5 on murder-related racketeering and weapons charges. he has pleaded not guilty in that case. more misc misc. california los angeles los angeles, california lil durk music federal court los angeles grammy awards

misc-lionel-messi-eldense-purchase-agree.excerpt: The transaction would transfer all shares held by majority owner TH Soluciones, subject to due diligence and Spanish regulatory approval.
misc-lionel-messi-eldense-purchase-agree.text: lionel messi reaches agreement to buy spanish club eldense the transaction would transfer all shares held by majority owner th soluciones, subject to due diligence and spanish regulatory approval. lionel messi has reached an agreement in principle to buy spanish second-division club eldense, the club said wednesday. the proposed transaction would give messi all shares currently held by majority owner th soluciones, reuters reported. the acquisition is not yet complete. it remains subject to due diligence, final legal and contractual steps and authorization from spain’s national sports council. the parties have not set a firm closing date. eldense was 20th in the segunda división when the agreement was announced. th soluciones took control of the club last october, making the proposed sale another ownership change in less than a year if regulators and the parties complete the process. messi, 39, has already expanded his involvement in club ownership. he purchased fifth-tier spanish side ue cornellà on april 16 and is expected to receive a stake in inter miami after his playing contract. the eldense deal would represent a larger step, but the club’s announcement should be read as a pending transaction rather than a completed transfer of control. more misc misc. international elda elda, spain lionel messi eldense soccer club ownership

misc-liv-golf-bankruptcy-financing-2026.excerpt: A New Jersey court approved first-day Chapter 11 relief that lets the golf circuit continue paying employees and vendors while it reorganizes.
misc-liv-golf-bankruptcy-financing-2026.text: liv golf wins interim access to $14 million in bankruptcy financing a new jersey court approved first-day chapter 11 relief that lets the golf circuit continue paying employees and vendors while it reorganizes. liv golf received interim court approval to access $14 million in bankruptcy financing, giving the professional golf circuit near-term cash to continue operations during its chapter 11 restructuring. a federal bankruptcy judge in new jersey approved the company’s first-day motions, including authority to pay wages, benefits and critical vendors. the interim amount is part of a proposed $49.6 million debtor-in-possession financing package backed by bc partners credit. liv filed for bankruptcy tuesday after financial pressures left players and other creditors owed millions of dollars, according to court documents cited by reuters. chapter 11 allows a company to keep operating while it negotiates a plan to reorganize debts under court supervision. the judge’s order is temporary and does not approve the full financing package or a final restructuring plan. a hearing on broader financing authority is scheduled for october 7. liv has said it hopes to emerge from bankruptcy in early 2027, but that timeline will depend on creditor negotiations, court approval and the company’s ability to fund ongoing tournaments. more misc misc. nj camden new jersey liv golf bankruptcy sports business new jersey

misc-logan-airport-911-flags-2026.excerpt: For 25 years, American flags near the gates used by Flights 11 and 175 have honored the passengers and crews who departed Boston on September 11, 2001.
misc-logan-airport-911-flags-2026.text: logan airport’s two 9/11 flags maintain a quiet memorial for 25 years, american flags near the gates used by flights 11 and 175 have honored the passengers and crews who departed boston on september 11, 2001. two american flags inside boston logan international airport have marked the departure points of american airlines flight 11 and united airlines flight 175 for nearly 25 years. the planes left logan on september 11, 2001, and were hijacked before striking the world trade center. airport workers placed the flags near the associated gates in the weeks after the attacks, creating a simple memorial visible to passengers and crews. the flags face the taxiways and have remained part of the terminal landscape through renovations and the passage of time. the tribute complements the airport’s public 9/11 memorial, which honors the passengers and crews aboard both flights. together, the sites connect a national tragedy to the specific place where those journeys began. as the 25th anniversary approaches, the flags carry a different kind of weight for travelers who were born after the attacks as well as for workers who remember that morning. they do not interrupt airport operations or require a ceremony to be noticed. their permanence is the point: a quiet, daily acknowledgement embedded in one of new england’s busiest public spaces. more ma boston, massachusetts logan airport september 11 memorial boston

misc-macklemore-ed-sheeran-tour-2026-09-.excerpt: The rapper says the remaining support dates were canceled after venue owners objected to his political comments at a New Jersey concert.
misc-macklemore-ed-sheeran-tour-2026-09-.text: macklemore dropped from ed sheeran’s u.s. tour after pro-palestinian remarks the rapper says the remaining support dates were canceled after venue owners objected to his political comments at a new jersey concert. rapper macklemore said monday that he was dropped from ed sheeran’s u.s. tour after making pro-palestinian remarks during a sept. 4 concert at metlife stadium in new jersey, reuters reported. the promoter for sheeran’s loop tour told rolling stone that venue owners had notified organizers they would not allow macklemore to perform on the remaining support dates. sheeran had no immediate public comment. macklemore was scheduled to appear at eight of the 10 remaining shows, which are set to resume sept. 19 in philadelphia. he said he and sheeran had difficult conversations during the past week. macklemore also said new england patriots owner robert kraft helped rally some stadium owners against keeping him on the tour. kraft said he felt responsible for speaking up when he believed a line had been crossed. the dispute reflects the continuing conflict over how artists’ political statements are handled at commercial events. macklemore denies being antisemitic and says criticism of israel should not be equated with antisemitism. more more misc. new jersey east rutherford east rutherford, new jersey misc. music macklemore ed sheeran

misc-marc-marquez-san-marino-motogp-spri.excerpt: The Ducati rider beat Marco Bezzecchi over 13 laps and moved within 14 points of MotoGP leader Jorge Martin.
misc-marc-marquez-san-marino-motogp-spri.text: marc marquez wins san marino sprint to tighten title race the ducati rider beat marco bezzecchi over 13 laps and moved within 14 points of motogp leader jorge martin. ducati rider marc marquez won the san marino grand prix sprint saturday, beating aprilia’s marco bezzecchi and cutting jorge martin’s motogp championship lead to 14 points. martin finished third, keeping the title fight compressed ahead of sunday’s full-distance race. bezzecchi started from pole after setting a lap record, but marquez moved ahead at the first turn and controlled the 13-lap sprint. he reinforced the performance with a race-lap record on the penultimate tour. bezzecchi’s runner-up finish leaves him 22 points behind martin in third place in the standings, preserving a three-rider contest near the top. sprint points have made saturdays increasingly important in motogp, and marquez converted track position into a material championship gain without waiting for the main event. the result also demonstrated ducati’s race pace against aprilia’s qualifying speed. sunday will offer more points and a longer strategic test, with tire management and launch execution likely to matter. for now, marquez’s victory ensures the san marino weekend will tighten rather than settle the title picture. more misc misc. italy misano adriatico misano adriatico, italy motogp marc marquez san marino grand prix motorcycle racing

misc-mets-marlins-15-14-comeback-2026.excerpt: New York recovered after Miami erased an 8-0 deficit, scoring six times in the seventh inning to complete a three-game sweep.
misc-mets-marlins-15-14-comeback-2026.text: mets survive blown eight-run lead to beat marlins 15-14 new york recovered after miami erased an 8-0 deficit, scoring six times in the seventh inning to complete a three-game sweep. the new york mets survived the loss of an eight-run lead and beat the miami marlins 15-14 on wednesday night, completing a three-game road sweep in one of the season’s most volatile games. new york led 8-0 in the third inning before miami scored three times in the fourth and five in the sixth to tie the game. the mets answered with six runs in the seventh, highlighted by francisco lindor’s three-run homer and christopher morel’s run-scoring single. morel finished 3-for-4 with three rbis as the mets extended their winning streak to four games. miami continued to pressure the bullpen, but tobias myers recorded the final two outs for his second save and preserved the one-run margin. the result improved new york’s run to 21-12 since the club sold at the trade deadline, according to reuters. a 15-14 score can obscure how dramatically control shifted: the mets built what appeared to be a comfortable advantage, surrendered all of it, then produced another major rally. the win mattered in the standings, but it also tested a reshaped roster’s ability to finish a game after momentum had fully reversed. more misc misc. us miami miami, fl new york mets miami marlins mlb baseball

misc-michael-kors-ny-fashion-week-2027-c.excerpt: The designer's spring-summer 2027 collection drew on the Museum of Modern Art sculpture garden with crisp shapes and vivid color.
misc-michael-kors-ny-fashion-week-2027-c.text: michael kors brings graphic stripes to new york fashion week the designer's spring-summer 2027 collection drew on the museum of modern art sculpture garden with crisp shapes and vivid color. michael kors presented his spring-summer 2027 collection friday at new york fashion week, using graphic stripes, sculptural shapes and bright accents in a show staged at the museum of modern art's sculpture garden. the collection moved between casual and formal warm-weather clothing, including one-shoulder evening gowns, professional two-piece sets and striped summer dresses. black and white dominated the palette, with red, green and yellow adding color. many looks were paired with the designer's signature handbags. guests included actors gabrielle union-wade, grace van patten and lea michele. the runway arrives during a business reset for the michael kors brand. parent company capri holdings lowered its annual revenue forecast last month, citing inventory delays and softer demand for expensive handbags and accessories. michael kors revenue fell to $590 million in the quarter ended june 27 from $635 million a year earlier, its 15th consecutive quarter of declining sales. capri has reduced promotions, updated stores and invested in new products as it tries to rebuild full-price demand. new york fashion week runs through september 15. more misc misc. ny new york city new york city, ny michael kors new york fashion week fashion capri holdings new york city

misc-nepal-tunnel-survivor-released-hosp.excerpt: Sanjay Sah said he survived without food by drinking floodwater and seepage before rescuers reached the mountain hydropower station.
misc-nepal-tunnel-survivor-released-hosp.text: nepal tunnel survivor leaves hospital after nine-day ordeal sanjay sah said he survived without food by drinking floodwater and seepage before rescuers reached the mountain hydropower station. sanjay sah was released from a kathmandu hospital friday after surviving nine days trapped inside a tunnel at nepal’s upper trishuli 3a hydropower station. floods and mudslides struck the bhotekoshi river area and tore through the facility, leaving the 30-year-old mechanical foreman isolated deep inside the mountainside powerhouse. sah told reuters that he had no food and survived by drinking floodwater and water seeping from the mountain rock. he spent long periods with his eyes closed because darkness and debris made movement hazardous. from an opening on the fifth floor of the six-story structure, he shouted in hopes of finding other survivors but heard no response. rescuers reached sah on the 10th day after the disaster. he said thoughts of his wife, young daughter and wider family helped him maintain hope. the rescue provided a rare positive outcome after the late-august collapse of a himalayan glacier caused widespread destruction across nepal and china’s tibet region, where authorities have reported heavy loss of life and thousands missing. more misc misc. nepal kathmandu kathmandu, nepal nepal floods rescue hydropower sanjay sah

misc-netherlands-football-fireworks-aban.excerpt: The national federation, prosecutors and justice ministry agreed on the tougher response after fans were injured last month.
misc-netherlands-football-fireworks-aban.text: dutch football will abandon matches when fireworks are used the national federation, prosecutors and justice ministry agreed on the tougher response after fans were injured last month. professional football matches in the netherlands will be abandoned when fireworks are used in the stands under a new safety agreement reported friday. the policy was reached by the dutch football federation knvb, the public prosecution service and justice and security minister david van weel. the measure follows an incident during sc cambuur’s league match against feyenoord in leeuwarden last month. fireworks thrown by visiting supporters left several fans with burns, hearing damage and eye injuries, according to reuters. stopping a match entirely is a stronger response than a temporary suspension. the agreement gives teams, officials and supporters a clear consequence when pyrotechnics are ignited, while authorities work to reduce injuries and disorder inside stadiums. implementation details, including how officials will handle identification, announcements and any appeals, were not set out in the initial report. the policy nevertheless changes the immediate calculus for clubs and fans: a single fireworks incident can now end the contest instead of merely delaying it. dutch football authorities will be watched for how consistently the rule is applied across venues and competitions. more misc misc. netherlands netherlands dutch football knvb fireworks stadium safety soccer

misc-new-york-city-post-911-health-air-r.text: new york city releases 170,000 pages of post-9/11 health and air records the disclosure documents the city’s response to the attacks and aftermath and resolves two lawsuits seeking access to health and air-quality files. new york city has released more than 170,000 pages of records documenting its response to the september 11 attacks and the years that followed, including files tied to health and air-quality concerns. mayor zohran mamdani announced the disclosure tuesday, september 8. reuters reported that the release accompanies settlements in two lawsuits seeking access to post-9/11 records. the city’s action makes a large body of material available ahead of the attacks’ 25th anniversary. the records could help survivors, families, researchers and journalists trace what officials knew, how agencies communicated and how environmental and health concerns were handled. their volume also means meaningful review will take time; releasing pages does not by itself establish what individual documents show. questions about exposure and long-term illness have remained central to the public record of the disaster and cleanup. the disclosure creates an opportunity for independent examination, but conclusions should be tied to specific documents and supporting evidence. additional reporting may identify gaps, duplicated material or records that require context from the agencies that created them. more misc misc. ny new york new york city, new york september 11 new york city public records air quality

misc-norway-princess-astrid-dies-94-2026.excerpt: The former first lady of Norway died two days after attending King Harald’s funeral and after a lifetime of royal service.
misc-norway-princess-astrid-dies-94-2026.text: norway’s princess astrid dies at 94 the former first lady of norway died two days after attending king harald’s funeral and after a lifetime of royal service. norway’s princess astrid died friday at age 94, the royal house announced. an older sister of the late king harald, she made her final public appearance wednesday at her brother’s funeral. the palace said flags would fly at half-staff from the royal palace balcony on the day of her death and again on the day of her funeral. astrid became norway’s first lady at age 22 after the death of her mother, crown princess märtha, in 1954. she served in that role for 14 years, assisting her father, king olav v, at official dinners, state visits and public celebrations. she continued royal duties after crown princess sonja assumed the first-lady role in 1968. the princess represented norway alongside three kings: her grandfather, father and brother. the royal house highlighted her work on care and inclusion for vulnerable people and her long support for charitable organizations. she married johan martin ferner in 1961 and had five children. her death came two weeks after king harald died at 89 following more than 35 years on the throne, closing an especially compressed period of loss for norway’s royal family. more misc misc. norway oslo oslo, norway princess astrid norway royal family king harald obituary

misc-oklahoma-state-upsets-oregon-39-31-.text: oklahoma state stuns no. 6 oregon 39-31 the 23.5-point underdogs ended a 21-game losing streak against fbs opponents with a late go-ahead touchdown run. unranked oklahoma state delivered the first major upset of the college football season saturday, beating no. 6 oregon 39-31 in stillwater. the cowboys entered as 23.5-point underdogs and had lost 21 consecutive games against football bowl subdivision opponents. quarterback drew mestemaker threw for 317 yards and accounted for three touchdowns despite two interceptions. his 10-yard touchdown run gave oklahoma state the lead late, and the cowboys’ defense held oregon off on its final chances. the result also gave eric morris his first victory as oklahoma state’s head coach. the win sharply reversed the teams’ meeting last season, when oregon routed the cowboys 69-3. oklahoma state also entered saturday coming off a loss to tulsa, making the turnaround even more pronounced. for oregon, the defeat creates an early setback in the national rankings and the race for college football playoff positioning. for the cowboys, the result ends a long drought against top-level opposition and gives the program a defining home victory early in morris’s tenure. more misc misc. oklahoma stillwater stillwater, oklahoma oklahoma state oregon college football upset

misc-ossipee-resident-lake-wish-2026.text: ossipee nursing-home program helps 93-year-old return to lake mountain view community arranged adaptive equipment so resident ruth beckwith could swim at wentworth state park with her family. a resident wish program at mountain view community in ossipee helped 93-year-old ruth beckwith return to a new hampshire lake with her family. beckwith, who uses a wheelchair and has difficulty getting into a car, visited wentworth state park in wolfeboro on august 19. she entered lake wentworth using a water wheelchair rented from northeast passage, the adaptive-recreation program at the university of new hampshire. family members, including several great-grandchildren, joined her for the outing. the visit fulfilled beckwith’s request to swim in a lake one more time and required coordination among nursing-home staff, relatives and the equipment provider. mountain view community is carroll county’s nursing home. the trip illustrates how adaptive recreation can make an ordinary family experience accessible to someone with limited mobility. the event was not a medical treatment or public program announcement; it was a personalized outing organized around one resident’s goal. for beckwith and her family, the result was a day together at the water. more nh ossipee and wolfeboro, new hampshire ossipee mountain view community adaptive recreation seniors

misc-patriots-aj-brown-ankle-injury-2026.text: patriots receiver a.j. brown leaves opener with right ankle injury brown walked off during new england’s first possession of the second half in seattle and was initially listed as questionable to return. new england patriots wide receiver a.j. brown left wednesday night’s season opener in seattle with a right ankle injury during the third quarter. brown was targeted by quarterback drake maye on third down when seahawks nickel cornerback nehemiah pritchett deflected the pass. pritchett’s knee landed on the outside of brown’s ankle as the receiver went to the turf, reuters reported. brown walked off, removed his right cleat and entered the sideline medical tent. the patriots initially listed him as questionable to return. he did not rejoin the offense when a roughing-the-punter penalty extended the possession. brown had three receptions for a team-high 26 yards in the first half. new england acquired brown from the philadelphia eagles in an early-june trade, making his availability an important early-season issue for the passing game. the initial report did not include a diagnosis, imaging result or recovery timeline. any assessment beyond a right ankle injury would therefore be premature until the team provides a medical update. more misc misc. ma seattle seattle, wa new england patriots a.j. brown nfl injury

misc-patriots-christian-gonzalez-contrac.text: patriots’ christian gonzalez agrees to record cornerback contract the four-year, $135 million deal would make gonzalez the highest-paid cornerback in nfl history, according to people who spoke with the ap. new england patriots cornerback christian gonzalez has agreed to a four-year, $135 million contract, a deal that would make him the highest-paid cornerback in nfl history, the associated press reported. two people with knowledge of the agreement told the ap that $102 million is guaranteed. they spoke anonymously because the team had not yet announced the contract publicly. the agreement gives gonzalez the long-term security he had been seeking after emerging as a central part of the patriots’ defense. for new england, it is also a major commitment to a young player before the season’s competitive stakes fully arrive. the contract reflects how quickly elite young defensive players can reset the market at a premium position. it also gives the patriots a clear signal of how they value gonzalez as the team builds around a core of long-term contributors. the team’s eventual announcement will establish the final terms. more misc misc. ma foxborough foxborough, ma new england patriots nfl sports foxborough massachusetts

misc-patriots-christian-gonzalez-extensi.text: patriots reportedly give christian gonzalez four-year, $135 million extension the reported agreement includes $102 million guaranteed and would reset the top of the nfl cornerback market. the new england patriots and cornerback christian gonzalez have agreed to a reported four-year, $135 million contract extension with $102 million guaranteed, according to boston.com’s account of multiple reports. if finalized on those terms, the agreement would make gonzalez the highest-paid cornerback in nfl history by reported average annual value. gonzalez appeared to confirm the deal in an instagram post, though the team had not released a full contract breakdown in the cited report. the agreement came less than 48 hours before new england’s season opener in seattle. it also followed seahawks cornerback devon witherspoon’s reported four-year, $132 million extension last month, illustrating how quickly the top of the position’s market has moved. gonzalez has developed into a central piece of the patriots’ defense, and the extension would keep him under contract through much of his prime. guaranteed money, bonus structure and salary-cap treatment can differ from a deal’s headline value, so the final filing will provide the clearest picture of the team’s long-term commitment. more misc misc. ma foxborough foxborough, ma new england patriots christian gonzalez nfl contracts

misc-plymouth-birthday-beach-wish-2026.excerpt: Community members helped Alison Blomgren reach the sand after her daughter asked for assistance fulfilling a birthday wish.
misc-plymouth-birthday-beach-wish-2026.text: plymouth volunteers help 94-year-old return to white horse beach community members helped alison blomgren reach the sand after her daughter asked for assistance fulfilling a birthday wish. a group of plymouth volunteers helped a 94-year-old woman return to white horse beach after her daughter asked the community for assistance with a birthday wish. nbc 10 wjar reported that alison blomgren wanted to put her toes in the sand at the beach she remembered from childhood. blomgren now lives in east tennessee and has faced health and mobility challenges, making the trip onto the beach difficult. her daughter, mari-jane shore, traveled with her to massachusetts and sought help moving a wheelchair across the sand. local residents responded, creating the support needed for blomgren to reach the shoreline and spend time with family at the beach. the visit followed the recent death of blomgren’s husband and came around her september 4 birthday. the story is small compared with the day’s larger headlines, but it shows how a practical request can mobilize neighbors quickly. the volunteers’ assistance turned a place tied to childhood memory into an accessible birthday destination decades later. more ma plymouth, massachusetts plymouth white horse beach community birthday

misc-rays-brewers-first-playoff-berths-2.text: rays and brewers become first teams to clinch mlb playoff berths tampa bay advanced on junior caminero’s walk-off homer, while milwaukee secured its place with a 20-run rout of cincinnati. the tampa bay rays and milwaukee brewers became the first major league baseball teams to secure 2026 postseason places friday, clinching in dramatically different fashion. tampa bay beat houston 3-1 on junior caminero’s walk-off home run, while milwaukee overwhelmed cincinnati 20-0. caminero drove a 417-foot homer off bryan abreu for his 40th of the season, turning a tie game into a celebration at tropicana field. the win guaranteed the rays a playoff berth with the regular season entering its final stretch. tampa bay’s pitching held houston to one run before the ninth-inning finish. milwaukee left little doubt in its clincher. garrett mitchell hit a grand slam, william contreras homered and drove in six runs, and dustin may allowed two hits over six scoreless innings. the brewers earned their eighth postseason appearance in nine seasons. with both clubs officially through, attention now shifts to division positioning and the remaining wild-card races as the rest of the field takes shape. more misc misc. florida st. petersburg st. petersburg, florida tampa bay rays milwaukee brewers mlb playoffs junior caminero baseball
