misc-remain-trailer-rhode-island-2026.text: first ‘remain’ trailer brings rhode island-shot thriller into view m. night shyamalan’s supernatural romance, filmed around the ocean state, pairs jake gyllenhaal and phoebe dynevor ahead of a february release. the first trailer for m. night shyamalan’s “remain” arrived tuesday, offering audiences an early look at the supernatural romantic thriller filmed around rhode island. entertainment weekly reported that jake gyllenhaal plays a reclusive architect who meets a mysterious woman, portrayed by phoebe dynevor, after moving to a coastal community. the preview begins with the tone of a romance before shifting toward the suspense associated with shyamalan’s films. the project grew from a story shyamalan developed with novelist nicholas sparks. shyamalan wrote and directed the screen version, while sparks produced a novel based on the same idea. the supporting cast includes ashley walters, julie hagerty and jay o. sanders. for rhode island, the trailer is also a showcase for a production that used locations around the state during filming, including coastal communities and providence-area sites. warner bros. has scheduled the movie for theatrical release on feb. 5, 2027. the trailer gives local viewers their first chance to see how familiar settings were transformed for the finished film. more ri rhode island rhode island film m. night shyamalan entertainment

misc-revolution-nycfc-september-9-2026.excerpt: New England enters an 8 p.m. match at Citi Field seeking points in its third consecutive road game.
misc-revolution-nycfc-september-9-2026.text: revolution continue road swing against new york city fc wednesday night new england enters an 8 p.m. match at citi field seeking points in its third consecutive road game. the new england revolution continue their road swing wednesday night with an 8 p.m. eastern match against new york city fc at citi field. it is new england’s third consecutive away game and the second meeting between the clubs in three weeks. the revolution entered the day fourth in the eastern conference and had won two of their previous three road matches, according to the club’s match preview. new england is trying to rebound from a 2-1 loss at the la galaxy in which carles gil converted a late penalty and the revolution struck the woodwork three times. the quick turnaround gives the club another chance to turn improved road performances into points before returning home. the team’s official match guide carries the latest broadcast, radio and lineup information. kickoff details can change because of weather or league operations, so supporters traveling to queens or planning to watch should confirm the schedule close to game time. final lineups and availability will be released nearer kickoff. more misc misc. ma foxborough new york city, new york new england revolution new york city fc mls citi field

misc-rhode-island-powerball-xs-os-2026.excerpt: The $5 game asks players to select eight team logos, with weekly drawings beginning September 13 and a rolling jackpot starting at $1 million.
misc-rhode-island-powerball-xs-os-2026.text: rhode island launches nfl-themed powerball xs & os game the $5 game asks players to select eight team logos, with weekly drawings beginning september 13 and a rolling jackpot starting at $1 million. the rhode island lottery has launched powerball xs & os, a football-themed draw game that uses nfl team logos rather than game scores. players choose eight logos from the league’s 32 teams. eight winning logos will be drawn at random each sunday at 10 p.m. beginning september 13. matching at least four can produce a cash prize, while matching all eight wins a rolling jackpot that starts at $1 million. the lottery emphasized that results are random and have no connection to nfl game outcomes. tickets cost $5 and are available from rhode island lottery retailers, rilot.com and the lottery’s mobile app. tickets can also generate entries for separate promotional drawings that may offer nfl merchandise, experiences or a super bowl trip. those promotions do not change the underlying odds of the draw game. as with any lottery product, buying a ticket does not guarantee a return, and the announced jackpot is a prize pool rather than a prediction that someone will win in a particular week. more ri cranston, rhode island rhode island lottery powerball nfl lottery

misc-robin-raikkonen-red-bull-developmen.excerpt: Robin Raikkonen will enter the Formula One team’s junior pipeline in 2027 after building experience in karting.
misc-robin-raikkonen-red-bull-developmen.text: kimi raikkonen’s 11-year-old son joins red bull development program robin raikkonen will enter the formula one team’s junior pipeline in 2027 after building experience in karting. robin raikkonen, the 11-year-old son of 2007 formula one world champion kimi raikkonen, will join red bull’s driver development program in 2027, reuters reported wednesday. the young racer, known as “ace” in karting, becomes the latest prospect connected to a formula one organization at an early stage of competition. red bull’s junior system has previously helped develop drivers including multiple world champions sebastian vettel and max verstappen. team principal laurent mekies said the program plans to support robin over the long term without placing unnecessary pressure on his progress. kimi raikkonen, who won 21 formula one races and recorded 103 podium finishes, remains ferrari’s most recent drivers’ world champion. a junior-program place is an opportunity for coaching and development rather than a guarantee of reaching formula one. young drivers still move through several levels of karting and single-seat racing, with results, funding and readiness shaping each step. robin’s entry also follows another recent family connection in the sport: ella hakkinen, daughter of two-time champion mika hakkinen, joined mclaren’s development program in 2025. more misc misc. international milton keynes milton keynes, united kingdom robin raikkonen red bull formula one karting

misc-russell-crowe-music-documentary-ven.excerpt: “What Love Builds” combines performances, archives and personal reflections to trace the actor's decades-long parallel career in music.
misc-russell-crowe-music-documentary-ven.text: russell crowe music documentary premieres in venice “what love builds” combines performances, archives and personal reflections to trace the actor's decades-long parallel career in music. russell crowe premiered a documentary about his lifelong involvement in music at the venice film festival on friday. “what love builds” uses performance footage, archival material and crowe's reflections to show how music has developed alongside an acting career best known for films including “gladiator” and “a beautiful mind.” crowe performs with indoor garden party, a group whose sound draws from rock, blues, country and gospel. the documentary grew from an idea first considered about 15 years ago and from an unusually large personal archive. reuters reported that the production had accumulated roughly 18 million feet of footage documenting rehearsals, concerts and the relationships around crowe's musical work. the film screened out of competition in venice, positioning it as a personal career portrait rather than an awards entry in the festival's main contest. crowe, now 62, remains active on screen while preparing a 2027 european tour with the band. the documentary's central argument is that his music is not a side project attached to celebrity, but a continuous creative pursuit that predates and accompanies his film career. more misc misc. italy venice venice, italy russell crowe venice film festival documentary music indoor garden party

misc-rybakina-first-us-open-title-2026.excerpt: Rybakina won 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 to claim her third major and end the defending champion’s 20-match Flushing Meadows streak.
misc-rybakina-first-us-open-title-2026.text: elena rybakina beats aryna sabalenka for first u.s. open title rybakina won 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 to claim her third major and end the defending champion’s 20-match flushing meadows streak. elena rybakina defeated two-time defending champion aryna sabalenka 6-4, 5-7, 6-2 saturday to win her first u.s. open singles title. the victory gave the 27-year-old from kazakhstan her third grand slam championship and ended sabalenka’s 20-match winning streak at flushing meadows. rybakina took the first set before sabalenka forced a decider. she regained control in the third, using her serve and first-strike power to pull away. the result denied sabalenka a third consecutive u.s. open crown and completed rybakina’s run through the tournament after an ankle injury had threatened her participation. the title follows rybakina’s victories at wimbledon in 2022 and the australian open earlier in 2026. she became the third woman this century to win both hard-court majors in the same season. the championship also places her at the top of the women’s rankings, the first player representing kazakhstan to reach world no. 1, and carried a $5.5 million prize. more misc misc. new york new york new york, new york elena rybakina aryna sabalenka u.s. open tennis

misc-rybakina-gauff-us-open-semifinal-20.excerpt: The incoming world No. 1 recovered from a set down for a 3-6, 6-4, 6-4 semifinal victory and will face defending champion Aryna Sabalenka.
misc-rybakina-gauff-us-open-semifinal-20.text: rybakina rallies past gauff to reach u.s. open final the incoming world no. 1 recovered from a set down for a 3-6, 6-4, 6-4 semifinal victory and will face defending champion aryna sabalenka. elena rybakina recovered from a set down to beat coco gauff 3-6, 6-4, 6-4 thursday night, earning a place in the u.s. open final against defending champion aryna sabalenka. gauff took the opening set with disciplined defense and a key service break. rybakina steadied in the second, used her power to shorten exchanges and forced a deciding set in front of the arthur ashe stadium crowd. the 27-year-old kazakh broke for a 5-3 lead in the third set. gauff immediately broke back, but rybakina closed the match by breaking serve again. the result keeps rybakina in contention for a third grand slam singles title and sets up a saturday final against a player seeking a third consecutive u.s. open championship. rybakina is already assured of replacing sabalenka as world no. 1 after the tournament. gauff’s loss, following jessica pegula’s defeat in the other semifinal, also means no american woman will appear in a grand slam final this year, the first season that has happened since 2006. more misc misc. ny new york new york elena rybakina coco gauff u.s. open tennis

misc-rybakina-us-open-semifinal-number-o.excerpt: The second seed rallied past Zheng Qinwen in three sets and will rise to the top of the women’s rankings after the tournament.
misc-rybakina-us-open-semifinal-number-o.text: elena rybakina reaches u.s. open semifinals and secures no. 1 ranking the second seed rallied past zheng qinwen in three sets and will rise to the top of the women’s rankings after the tournament. elena rybakina reached the u.s. open semifinals wednesday and secured the world no. 1 ranking for the first time with a 3-6, 6-1, 6-4 victory over qualifier zheng qinwen. the second seed recovered after losing the opening set and finished with 20 winners. zheng, returning from a chronic elbow injury, had advanced through qualifying before extending rybakina to three sets in the quarterfinal. rybakina will replace aryna sabalenka at the top of the rankings when they are updated after the tournament. she will next face either fifth seed mirra andreeva or 2023 champion coco gauff for a place in the final. the result adds another major milestone to a season in which rybakina won the australian open. zheng’s run also marked a significant return after injury, but a late double fault surrendered the decisive break and allowed rybakina to close the match. zheng received sustained applause as she left the court. more misc misc. ny new york new york, ny u.s. open elena rybakina tennis new york

misc-sabalenka-pegula-us-open-final-2026.excerpt: The world No. 1 advanced 7-5, 6-2 and will play for a third consecutive title at Flushing Meadows.
misc-sabalenka-pegula-us-open-final-2026.text: sabalenka beats pegula to reach fourth straight u.s. open final the world no. 1 advanced 7-5, 6-2 and will play for a third consecutive title at flushing meadows. aryna sabalenka defeated american jessica pegula 7-5, 6-2 to reach her fourth consecutive u.s. open final and move within one victory of a third straight title in new york. the world no. 1 recovered from a tightly contested opening set and took control with her serve and first-strike power. sabalenka finished with 29 winners and seven aces, limiting pegula’s opportunities to extend rallies and preventing the american from building momentum in the second set. sabalenka will face either coco gauff or elena rybakina in saturday’s championship match. the matchup gives her another chance to reinforce a dominant recent run at flushing meadows after winning the previous two tournaments. a victory would make sabalenka the first woman since serena williams to win three consecutive u.s. open singles titles. in the open era, only williams and chris evert have completed that streak. pegula’s loss ends another deep run at her home major after she reached the semifinals for a third straight year. more misc misc. ny new york new york, ny u.s. open aryna sabalenka jessica pegula tennis

misc-sabalenka-rybakina-us-open-final-20.excerpt: Aryna Sabalenka seeks a third consecutive New York title against Elena Rybakina, who is due to become world No. 1 after the tournament.
misc-sabalenka-rybakina-us-open-final-20.text: sabalenka and rybakina set heavyweight u.s. open final aryna sabalenka seeks a third consecutive new york title against elena rybakina, who is due to become world no. 1 after the tournament. aryna sabalenka and elena rybakina will meet in saturday’s u.s. open women’s final, pairing two of the sport’s biggest servers in a championship match with rankings and history attached. sabalenka is seeking a third consecutive title in new york, a run no woman has completed since serena williams won three straight through 2014. rybakina is set to become world no. 1 when the rankings are updated monday, regardless of the final’s outcome. the match will be the third grand slam final between the two. sabalenka won their 2023 australian open title match, while rybakina reversed that result at this year’s australian open. sabalenka leads their head-to-head series 10-7, but the margins have often been narrow because both players can shorten points with first-strike tennis. the contrast is less about power than temperament and execution under pressure: sabalenka brings an expressive, aggressive style, while rybakina is known for a more restrained presence. their latest meeting will decide the season’s final major and add another chapter to one of the tour’s defining rivalries. more misc misc. new york new york new york, new york u.s. open aryna sabalenka elena rybakina tennis grand slam

misc-saffie-osborne-first-female-british.excerpt: Osborne rode 11-1 Highwayman to victory in the St Leger Stakes on the race’s 250th anniversary.
misc-saffie-osborne-first-female-british.text: saffie osborne becomes first female jockey to win a british classic osborne rode 11-1 highwayman to victory in the st leger stakes on the race’s 250th anniversary. saffie osborne made british horse-racing history saturday by riding highwayman to victory in the st leger stakes at doncaster. she became the first female jockey to win one of the five classics of british flat racing, reaching the milestone on the 250th anniversary of the world’s oldest classic. highwayman entered at odds of 11-1 and finished two-and-a-half lengths ahead of enceladus, giving trainer joseph o’brien a one-two result. amelia earhart placed third at 22-1 before a crowd of about 30,000. the st leger, first run in 1776, is the final british classic of the season. osborne had not expected to ride in the race a week earlier, making the late opportunity and victory especially striking. women had won many prominent races in britain before saturday, but none of the classics: the 1,000 guineas, 2,000 guineas, oaks, derby and st leger. her win breaks that barrier in the oldest of the five. more misc misc. england doncaster doncaster, england saffie osborne st leger stakes horse racing british classics

misc-seahawks-patriots-super-bowl-rematc.excerpt: Seattle’s backup quarterback led two late scoring drives while New England threw three fourth-quarter interceptions in a 13-10 loss.
misc-seahawks-patriots-super-bowl-rematc.text: seahawks rally past patriots 13-10 in super bowl rematch seattle’s backup quarterback led two late scoring drives while new england threw three fourth-quarter interceptions in a 13-10 loss. the seattle seahawks erased a 10-point deficit and defeated the new england patriots 13-10 wednesday night in a rematch of last season’s super bowl. seattle backup quarterback drew lock entered after starter sam darnold injured his hip on the opening drive. the seahawks managed only a field goal through three quarters before lock connected with jaxon smith-njigba for a 45-yard touchdown on fourth-and-1. three fourth-quarter interceptions by seattle’s defense turned the game. nehemiah pritchett and julian love picked off drake maye to set up the comeback and go-ahead field goal. josh jobe then made a toe-tapping interception in the end zone during new england’s final drive to preserve the win. maye threw a 2-yard touchdown pass to rookie eli raridon in the first half, and andy borregales added a 50-yard field goal. patriots receiver a.j. brown left with a right-ankle injury. new england returns home to face pittsburgh on september 20. more misc misc. ma seattle seattle, wa new england patriots seattle seahawks nfl drake maye

misc-shelton-tiafoe-historic-us-open-sem.excerpt: Friday’s U.S. Open matchup will be the first Open Era Grand Slam semifinal between two Black American men, guaranteeing a home finalist.
misc-shelton-tiafoe-historic-us-open-sem.text: shelton-tiafoe semifinal makes grand slam history for black american men friday’s u.s. open matchup will be the first open era grand slam semifinal between two black american men, guaranteeing a home finalist. ben shelton and frances tiafoe will meet friday in the first grand slam semifinal between two black american men in the open era, adding a historic milestone to the u.s. open. the matchup guarantees an american finalist and follows separate quarterfinal victories that moved both players within one win of the championship round. shelton and tiafoe have shared arthur ashe stadium before: they met in the 2023 u.s. open quarterfinals, giving friday’s contest a recent competitive history as well as broader significance. tiafoe also reached the u.s. open semifinals in 2024. shelton has since added major hard-court credentials, including two masters 1000 titles and a victory in montreal in august 2026. their progress reflects a deeper group of american men contending late at major tournaments. the tournament also has an important parallel in the women’s draw, where coco gauff advanced to the semifinals after rallying past mirra andreeva. the shelton-tiafoe match should be judged on tactics and form, but its place in tennis history is already established: for the first time in the open era, two black american men will share a major semifinal stage. more misc misc. ny new york new york, ny ben shelton frances tiafoe u.s. open tennis

misc-siniakova-townsend-us-open-career-g.excerpt: The top seeds rallied past Ashlyn Krueger and Robin Montgomery in three sets to capture the U.S. Open women's doubles title.
misc-siniakova-townsend-us-open-career-g.text: siniakova and townsend complete team career grand slam the top seeds rallied past ashlyn krueger and robin montgomery in three sets to capture the u.s. open women's doubles title. katerina siniakova and taylor townsend completed a career grand slam as a team friday, rallying to win the u.s. open women's doubles final 5-7, 6-0, 6-2 over american wild cards ashlyn krueger and robin montgomery in new york. the top-seeded pair recovered decisively after dropping the first set. early in the second, they won 23 of 27 points to force a deciding set, then consolidated an early break as townsend held for a 4-2 lead. the turnaround erased a difficult opening frame in which siniakova double-faulted three times while serving to force a tiebreak. siniakova and townsend had already won wimbledon in 2024, the australian open in 2025 and the french open earlier this year. adding the u.s. open made them champions at all four majors together. the victory was siniakova's 12th grand slam doubles title and made her the first player to complete a team career grand slam with two different partners; she previously accomplished the feat with barbora krejcikova. for townsend, the title completed a partnership arc that included a runner-up finish in new york last year. more misc misc. ny new york city new york city, ny u.s. open katerina siniakova taylor townsend tennis grand slam

misc-springboks-all-blacks-baltimore-ser.excerpt: South Africa scored six tries before 68,173 spectators and completed the four-test rivalry series with a 3-1 record.
misc-springboks-all-blacks-baltimore-ser.text: springboks beat all blacks 43-28 in baltimore to clinch series south africa scored six tries before 68,173 spectators and completed the four-test rivalry series with a 3-1 record. south africa defeated new zealand 43-28 in baltimore on saturday, winning for a third consecutive weekend to claim the four-test “rugby’s greatest rivalry” series 3-1. the world champion springboks scored six tries in the finale before an announced crowd of 68,173 at m&t bank stadium. damian de allende, morne van den berg, malcolm marx, pieter-steph du toit, kurt-lee arendse and cameron hanekom crossed for south africa. new zealand captain codie taylor scored the opening try, with will jordan, ethan blackadder and beauden barrett also finding the try line for the all blacks. south africa led 17-14 at halftime and created its decisive advantage after bringing on its replacement forwards early in the second half. marx and du toit scored in quick succession to make it 29-14. the baltimore match ended new zealand’s eight-game, six-week tour connected to the rivalry series, the first extended tour of its kind in 30 years. more misc misc. maryland baltimore baltimore, maryland springboks all blacks rugby baltimore

misc-stoughton-stanley-cup-2026.excerpt: Carolina Hurricanes equipment manager Jorge Alves, a 1997 Stoughton graduate, will bring the championship trophy to his former school.
misc-stoughton-stanley-cup-2026.text: stanley cup coming to stoughton high school thursday carolina hurricanes equipment manager jorge alves, a 1997 stoughton graduate, will bring the championship trophy to his former school. the stanley cup is coming to stoughton high school on thursday after carolina hurricanes equipment manager jorge alves arranged a visit to his former school, boston 25 news reported. alves graduated from stoughton high school in 1997. the carolina hurricanes won the 2026 stanley cup, and nhl tradition gives members of the championship team an opportunity to spend a day with the trophy. the school said alves will bring the cup to stoughton from 2:30 to 4:15 p.m. thursday. the event is free and open to the public, according to the report. the visit gives a local connection to the hurricanes’ championship season and turns a familiar school gym or campus setting into a celebration of a stoughton graduate’s role behind the team. the trophy visit is expected to draw students, alumni and local hockey fans who want to see one of sports’ most recognizable prizes in person. school officials said the public will be able to attend during the scheduled afternoon window. more misc misc. ma stoughton stoughton, ma massachusetts stoughton carolina hurricanes stanley cup

misc-thai-f2-driver-fiery-madring-crash-.excerpt: Tasanapol Inthraphuvasak climbed from his burning car without assistance after hitting the barriers during practice in Madrid.
misc-thai-f2-driver-fiery-madring-crash-.text: thai formula two driver escapes fiery madring crash tasanapol inthraphuvasak climbed from his burning car without assistance after hitting the barriers during practice in madrid. thai formula two driver tasanapol inthraphuvasak escaped without injury after his car crashed and caught fire during friday practice at madrid’s new madring circuit. the accident was the first major crash of the spanish grand prix weekend. the 20-year-old lost control at turn 19 and spun backward into the barriers. flames spread through the wreckage, but inthraphuvasak climbed out of the cockpit without assistance and made his way over the wall, reuters reported. officials stopped the session with a red flag. marshals took time to reach the car with extinguishers, and the track was not cleared for about 24 minutes. practice resumed with only six minutes remaining, sharply limiting running for the rest of the field. the crash occurred before formula one cars began their own work at the newly built street circuit. drivers had already raised questions about risks associated with the venue. inthraphuvasak’s quick exit prevented injury, but the fire and response time will give organizers and racing officials clear evidence to review as the weekend continues. more misc misc. spain madrid madrid, spain formula two tasanapol inthraphuvasak madring spanish grand prix motorsport

misc-tommy-hilfiger-plaza-nyfw-2026.excerpt: The designer presented his spring and summer 2027 collection inside the Manhattan hotel, with Gigi Hadid opening the show.
misc-tommy-hilfiger-plaza-nyfw-2026.text: tommy hilfiger returns to new york fashion week at the plaza the designer presented his spring and summer 2027 collection inside the manhattan hotel, with gigi hadid opening the show. tommy hilfiger returned to new york fashion week on thursday with a spring and summer 2027 show staged in the lobby of manhattan’s plaza hotel. model gigi hadid opened the presentation, which featured oversized polo shirts, plaid bucket hats and a palette built around red, navy and other bold colors. guests watched from green armchairs arranged through the hotel lobby, turning the landmark interior into part of the collection’s visual setting. the location carried a personal connection for hilfiger, who lived in a plaza penthouse for more than a decade. now 75, the designer founded his namesake brand in 1985 and said the label is continuing to pursue younger shoppers, including generation z. the company is owned by pvh. attendees included kate moss, camila cabello, jisoo, new york knicks players karl-anthony towns and josh hart, and actor patrick schwarzenegger. the event took place on the first official day of the fashion-week calendar and used a familiar new york institution to frame hilfiger’s latest take on american sportswear. more misc misc. new york new york city new york city, ny tommy hilfiger new york fashion week the plaza fashion

misc-topsfield-fair-scam-emails-2026.excerpt: Fair organizers say vendors should be cautious about messages that appear to come from the event and request sensitive information or payments.
misc-topsfield-fair-scam-emails-2026.text: topsfield fair warns vendors about scam emails fair organizers say vendors should be cautious about messages that appear to come from the event and request sensitive information or payments. the topsfield fair is warning vendors about scam emails that appear to be connected to the event, boston 25 news reported tuesday. organizers urged vendors to be cautious with messages from scammers and to verify requests through official fair contacts before sending money, account details or other sensitive information. the initial report did not identify a confirmed loss or disclose how many vendors were targeted. the warning arrives as fairs and seasonal events exchange large volumes of applications, invoices and logistics messages. that makes familiar names and deadlines useful cover for phishing attempts, especially when a request pressures a recipient to act quickly. vendors should avoid clicking unexpected links, confirm payment instructions independently and report suspicious messages to the fair or the relevant email provider. the fair’s warning is a reminder that local events are also targets for routine online fraud. the fair’s message did not identify a confirmed loss, so vendors should treat the warning as prevention rather than evidence of a broader breach. more misc misc. ma topsfield topsfield, ma massachusetts topsfield fair scams small business

misc-uganda-tooro-king-oyo-burial-succes.excerpt: The monarch who took the throne at age 3 is being laid to rest in Fort Portal after his death at 34 and a contested choice of successor.
misc-uganda-tooro-king-oyo-burial-succes.text: uganda’s tooro kingdom buries king oyo amid succession dispute the monarch who took the throne at age 3 is being laid to rest in fort portal after his death at 34 and a contested choice of successor. uganda’s tooro kingdom prepared to bury king oyo nyimba on saturday in fort portal after days of dispute over who should succeed him. royal guards led a procession carrying his flag-draped casket from the palace to st. john’s cathedral, where hundreds of mourners and senior government officials gathered before the burial at the royal tombs. oyo became internationally known in 1995 when he took the throne at age 3. he died in the united states in late august at 34 while receiving cancer treatment. during his reign he served as a united nations goodwill ambassador and promoted efforts against hiv and aids, while the kingdom remained an important source of cultural identity in western uganda. a royal clan committee selected oyo’s cousin edward rukidi kijanangoma as king, but oyo’s immediate family said a previously unknown son should inherit under the late monarch’s will. supporters of kijanangoma questioned whether enough information about the purported son had been produced. ugandan authorities strengthened security as the kingdom moved ahead with the funeral and its traditional succession rites. more misc misc. uganda fort portal fort portal, uganda king oyo tooro kingdom uganda fort portal royal succession

misc-ultimate-championship-ingebrigtsen-.excerpt: Track and field stars delivered on the opening night of the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship before a sold-out Budapest crowd.
misc-ultimate-championship-ingebrigtsen-.text: ingebrigtsen, duplantis and mahuchikh win on ultimate opener track and field stars delivered on the opening night of the inaugural world athletics ultimate championship before a sold-out budapest crowd. jakob ingebrigtsen returned from achilles surgery with a season-best 12:59.24 victory in the 5,000 meters friday, highlighting the opening night of the inaugural world athletics ultimate championship in budapest. the norwegian finished ahead of americans cole hocker and parker wolfe and earned the event’s $150,000 first prize. pole-vault world-record holder mondo duplantis cleared 6.20 meters to win his event, with greece’s emmanouil karalis second at 6.15. duplantis then made three attempts at 6.32 meters, which would have raised his world record, but gusting wind complicated the record effort. ukraine’s yaroslava mahuchikh also won the women’s high jump on a night built around head-to-head appearances by leading athletes. a sold-out crowd of 20,557 attended the first session. world athletics created the championship as a compact season-ending showcase with a $10 million total prize pool, the largest for a track and field meet. friday’s results supplied the competition outcomes that the new format needed: recognizable champions, close contests and an immediate test of whether larger purses can strengthen the sport’s post-championship calendar. more misc misc. hungary budapest budapest, hungary world athletics jakob ingebrigtsen mondo duplantis yaroslava mahuchikh budapest

misc-ultimate-championship-record-prize-.excerpt: Individual winners can earn $150,000 at the new Budapest meet, part of a faster presentation built around elite head-to-head events.
misc-ultimate-championship-record-prize-.text: ultimate championship debuts with record prize money for track individual winners can earn $150,000 at the new budapest meet, part of a faster presentation built around elite head-to-head events. world athletics is launching its inaugural ultimate championship in budapest with the richest prize structure in the sport’s history. winners of individual events will receive $150,000, while the winning relay teams will divide $80,000, creating a significant incentive for athletes at the new showcase meet. retired sprint champion usain bolt said the payouts would have attracted him during his career. a sprinter competing in the 100 meters, 200 meters and mixed 4x100 relay could contend for multiple awards across the program, although each event still requires qualification and victory against an elite field. organizers designed a streamlined schedule with less downtime, theatrical lighting and a black infield. world athletics president sebastian coe described the championship as a place to test presentation changes while focusing attention on recognizable athletes and direct competition. the experiment addresses a persistent challenge for track and field: major championships command broad audiences, but many meets struggle for attention between olympic cycles. bigger prizes and a compact format do not guarantee long-term success, but they give athletes a stronger financial reward and provide the governing body with a clear test of whether a faster, star-centered event can attract new viewers. more misc misc. hungary budapest budapest, hungary world athletics ultimate championship usain bolt budapest

misc-welles-crowther-medal-freedom-2026.excerpt: The Boston College graduate and volunteer firefighter was honored posthumously for helping people escape the World Trade Center on Sept. 11.
misc-welles-crowther-medal-freedom-2026.text: ‘man in the red bandana’ welles crowther awarded medal of freedom the boston college graduate and volunteer firefighter was honored posthumously for helping people escape the world trade center on sept. 11. president donald trump posthumously awarded the presidential medal of freedom tuesday to welles crowther, the boston college graduate remembered as the “man in the red bandana” for rescuing people at the world trade center on sept. 11, 2001. crowther, an equities trader and volunteer firefighter, repeatedly guided people from the south tower’s upper floors toward safety before the building collapsed. survivors later connected their unknown rescuer to crowther through the red bandana he carried, a habit that became central to his legacy. whdh reported that crowther is credited with helping save as many as 18 people. his mother, alison crowther, accepted the honor and said it would be treasured by the family for generations. the award comes days before the 25th anniversary of the attacks and renews attention on a story with deep new england ties. boston college has memorialized crowther through an annual 5k and other campus traditions. the medal, the nation’s highest civilian honor, recognizes his courage and the lives he helped save. more ma boston, massachusetts welles crowther boston college september 11 medal of freedom

misc-werro-hodgkinson-ultimate-800-title.excerpt: The 22-year-old Swiss runner led throughout and finished in 1:55.88 ahead of Olympic champion Keely Hodgkinson.
misc-werro-hodgkinson-ultimate-800-title.text: audrey werro beats keely hodgkinson for ultimate championship 800-meter title the 22-year-old swiss runner led throughout and finished in 1:55.88 ahead of olympic champion keely hodgkinson. switzerland’s audrey werro won the women’s 800 meters at the inaugural world athletics ultimate championship in budapest, defeating olympic champion keely hodgkinson in one of the meet’s most anticipated races. werro led from the front and finished in 1 minute, 55.88 seconds. hodgkinson placed second in 1:56.26, while femke broeders-bol finished third. the victory completed an unbeaten outdoor season for the 22-year-old werro, whose rapid rise has made the women’s 800 one of track’s most competitive events. her season included a european title and a personal best of 1:53.70. werro earned $150,000 from the championship’s $10 million prize pool. beyond the payout, the win gave her the first ultimate championship title in the event and another direct victory over an established olympic champion. the result also reinforced the depth of the current 800-meter rivalry, with several runners producing times that have renewed attention around a world record that has stood since 1983. budapest closed werro’s outdoor campaign with a controlled championship performance rather than a late tactical surge. more misc misc. hungary budapest budapest, hungary audrey werro keely hodgkinson 800 meters ultimate championship

misc-western-athletes-kyrgyzstan-nomad-g.excerpt: The biennial event brought participants from more than 100 countries together for horse archery, wrestling, falconry and traditional games.
misc-western-athletes-kyrgyzstan-nomad-g.text: western athletes join 3,000 competitors at kyrgyzstan’s nomad games the biennial event brought participants from more than 100 countries together for horse archery, wrestling, falconry and traditional games. more than 3,000 athletes from over 100 countries took part in the sixth world nomad games in kyrgyzstan, organizers said. the biennial competition returned to the country where it began in 2014, using traditional sports to combine international competition with central asian culture. events included horseback archery, several wrestling styles, falconry, tug of war and traditional board games. the program also featured kok boru, a mounted team sport often compared with polo but played with a sheep carcass instead of a ball. among the western participants was british horseback archer becca sweetman, who has competed for great britain after taking up the sport eight years ago. a british tug-of-war group also traveled to the event, reflecting the games’ widening reach beyond countries where nomadic competitions remain part of everyday sporting culture. the setting in the mountainous issyk-kul region is central to the event’s identity, not merely a backdrop. by drawing competitors who learned the disciplines abroad, the games are developing into both a cultural showcase and a serious international meet. their growth also offers lesser-known sports a rare stage alongside the global calendar’s established competitions. more misc misc. kyrgyzstan issyk-kul region, kyrgyzstan world nomad games kyrgyzstan horse archery traditional sports

misc-woman-unknown-golden-lion-venice-20.excerpt: May el-Toukhy’s postwar drama took the Golden Lion, while lead performer Mathilde Arcel won best actress.
misc-woman-unknown-golden-lion-venice-20.text: “woman unknown” wins golden lion at venice film festival may el-toukhy’s postwar drama took the golden lion, while lead performer mathilde arcel won best actress. danish filmmaker may el-toukhy’s postwar drama “woman unknown” won the golden lion for best film at the 2026 venice film festival. the film’s lead, mathilde arcel, also received the festival’s best actress award, giving the production two of the closing ceremony’s most prominent honors. set after world war ii, the film follows a danish housemaid whose past relationship with a german soldier threatens her future and exposes the public punishment faced by women accused of fraternizing with occupying forces. el-toukhy was the only woman among the 21 directors in the festival’s main competition, a disparity that remained part of the discussion around this year’s lineup. other major awards went to lee chang-dong’s “possible love,” which received the silver lion grand jury prize, and ilya khrzhanovsky, who won best director for “dau.” john malkovich took best actor for “wild horse nine.” the golden lion is closely watched because venice opens the international awards season and often provides an early platform for films and performances that later contend for major prizes. “woman unknown” leaves the festival with both its top film award and recognition for its central performance. more misc misc. italy venice venice, italy venice film festival woman unknown may el-toukhy golden lion

misc-yankees-mets-subway-series-playoff-.excerpt: The Yankees beat the Mets 2-0 in the final Subway Series game Sunday, moving within one win of securing a postseason spot.
misc-yankees-mets-subway-series-playoff-.text: yankees move closer to playoff berth with 2-0 win over mets the yankees beat the mets 2-0 in the final subway series game sunday, moving within one win of securing a postseason spot. the new york yankees moved to the edge of a playoff berth sunday by shutting out the new york mets 2-0 in the final game of the season’s subway series, reuters reported. cam schlittler held the mets to one hit over six innings and struck out eight. his performance lowered his major-league-leading earned-run average to 1.949, according to the report. ben rice and austin wells each hit a solo home run for new york. the yankees have won 18 of their last 26 games, and their magic number to clinch a postseason place is now one. the victory gave the yankees another strong finish in a rivalry series that draws attention across the region. new york can secure its playoff spot with one more win or with a loss by the team directly behind it in the standings, depending on the league’s remaining results. the report remains subject to further verified updates as officials continue reviewing the circumstances. more more misc. new york bronx bronx, new york misc. baseball new york yankees

misc-yolanda-celucci-obituary-2026.excerpt: A prominent figure in the region’s fashion community, Celucci also helped raise millions of dollars for charity through the Waltham Lions Club.
misc-yolanda-celucci-obituary-2026.text: boston fashion designer and philanthropist yolanda celucci dies at 91 a prominent figure in the region’s fashion community, celucci also helped raise millions of dollars for charity through the waltham lions club. yolanda celucci, a longtime boston fashion designer and philanthropist known across the region’s style and charitable communities, has died at age 91. whdh reported that celucci worked with celebrities, designers and presidents during a career that made her a prominent figure in boston fashion. she also used that visibility to support charitable fundraising. through the waltham lions club, celucci helped raise millions of dollars for charity, according to the station. that work connected her fashion career with causes serving people in greater boston and beyond. the report did not state a cause of death or provide funeral arrangements. celucci is survived by a daughter, grandchildren and great-grandchildren. her legacy rests in both the public events and designs that shaped boston’s fashion scene and the fundraising relationships she built over decades. additional details about memorial services may be released by her family or community organizations. her death closes a notable chapter in the region’s creative and civic life. more ma boston, massachusetts boston fashion yolanda celucci philanthropy

misc-zverev-us-open-final-khachanov-2026.excerpt: The French Open champion beat Karen Khachanov in straight sets and will play for his second major title Sunday.
misc-zverev-us-open-final-khachanov-2026.text: zverev reaches u.s. open final without dropping a set in four matches the french open champion beat karen khachanov in straight sets and will play for his second major title sunday. alexander zverev advanced to the u.s. open final friday with a 6-3, 7-6(7), 7-6(6) victory over karen khachanov. the top seed controlled the opening set and survived two close tiebreaks to reach his third consecutive grand slam final and his second championship match at flushing meadows. zverev needed five sets in each of his first two matches in new york, but his tournament changed after that difficult start. he has now won four straight matches without dropping a set. the victory improved his 2026 record at major tournaments to 24-2 and moved the reigning french open champion within one win of a second grand slam title. sunday's final will match zverev against the winner of the all-american semifinal between frances tiafoe and ben shelton. zverev's previous u.s. open final came in 2020, when he lost to dominic thiem after taking a two-set lead in a stadium closed to spectators during the pandemic. this time he will face a sold-out arthur ashe stadium and, potentially, a crowd strongly backing an american opponent. more misc misc. new york new york new york, new york alexander zverev u.s. open karen khachanov tennis grand slam

misc-zverev-us-open-semifinal-2026.excerpt: The German defeated Botic van de Zandschulp 6-2, 7-5, 6-1 and will face Karen Khachanov for a place in the final.
misc-zverev-us-open-semifinal-2026.text: alexander zverev reaches u.s. open semifinals in straight sets the german defeated botic van de zandschulp 6-2, 7-5, 6-1 and will face karen khachanov for a place in the final. alexander zverev reached the u.s. open semifinals thursday by defeating botic van de zandschulp 6-2, 7-5, 6-1 at arthur ashe stadium. zverev overcame five early double faults and broke in the fifth game of the opening set. van de zandschulp threatened to level the match in the second, but the german won three straight games late in the set and carried the momentum into a one-sided third. the victory sends zverev into a semifinal against karen khachanov, a rematch of their gold-medal match at the tokyo olympics in 2021. zverev, the 2020 u.s. open runner-up and reigning french open champion, has now reached the semifinals at all four majors this season. his 23 grand slam match wins in 2026 also surpassed boris becker’s 1989 record of 22 for a german man in one year, according to reuters. zverev is the only player remaining in the men’s draw who has already won a major title, but he still needs two victories in new york to add a second grand slam championship. more misc misc. ny new york new york, ny alexander zverev u.s. open tennis karen khachanov

mistral-record-funding.excerpt: The French AI company’s €3 billion raise values it at roughly €21 billion and adds another data point to the global infrastructure and model-building boom.
mistral-record-funding.text: mistral raises record funding round as the ai race accelerates the french ai company’s €3 billion raise values it at roughly €21 billion and adds another data point to the global infrastructure and model-building boom. french ai company mistral has raised €3 billion in a funding round that values the three-year-old company at roughly €21 billion, according to reuters. the round was led by psg equity and included samsung electronics and the eu-backed scaleup europe fund. mistral plans to use the money to expand its ai models, research and cloud offerings. the deal makes mistral one of europe’s most valuable private technology companies as governments and investors push for more domestic alternatives in a market dominated by u.s. and chinese competitors. for new england readers, the funding is another signal that demand for engineers, data-center capacity and ai services is likely to remain a major force across the technology economy. tech ma global tech ai startups venture capital europe

more-celine-dion-comeback-concert-paris-.excerpt: Celine Dion returned to the stage in Paris for her first full concert in more than six years after stepping back because of stiff-person syndrome.
more-celine-dion-comeback-concert-paris-.text: celine dion stuns fans with emotional comeback concert celine dion returned to the stage in paris for her first full concert in more than six years after stepping back because of stiff-person syndrome. celine dion returned to the stage in paris for her first full concert in more than six years, the associated press reported. the performance marked a major public appearance for the singer after she stepped back from touring while managing stiff-person syndrome. dion’s paris engagement is scheduled to include 26 shows. her return has drawn attention not only because of her catalog and long career, but also because the performances test how she can work around a condition that affects movement and can cause painful muscle spasms. the comeback concert gives dion a new way to reconnect with audiences while setting a measured pace for her return. the ap report described an emotional reception from fans, but the larger significance is practical as well: the singer is resuming live work on a schedule built around her health. her return also remains subject to the physical demands of performing, making each scheduled appearance part of a gradual recovery. more misc misc. france paris paris, france celine dion paris music concerts

more-usa-france-womens-world-cup-2026-09.excerpt: The United States rallied from a 14-point deficit to beat France 97-79 in the final and win a fifth straight Women’s World Cup.
more-usa-france-womens-world-cup-2026-09.text: usa overcome 14-point deficit, beat france 97-79 to win women’s world cup the united states rallied from a 14-point deficit to beat france 97-79 in the final and win a fifth straight women’s world cup. the united states overcame a 14-point deficit to beat france 97-79 in the women’s world cup final sunday, reuters reported. the victory gave the americans their fifth consecutive title and extended a 20-year unbeaten run across the olympics and world cup. breanna stewart led the united states with 22 points as the team recovered from a difficult start. france reached the final for the first time and finished with its best result in the tournament, but the americans’ second-half response turned a close contest into a clear win. the result continues the united states’ long dominance of international women’s basketball while giving france a landmark finish to build on. the final also underscored the value of composure after the americans fell behind by 14 before taking control. france’s first final appearance nevertheless gave the tournament a new competitive storyline, while the united states added another title to a run that has defined the event for a generation. more misc misc. germany germany united states france women’s basketball world cup

ne-20260914-bmc-nurses-strike-vote.excerpt: Nearly 90% of the hospital’s union-represented nurses backed a strike authorization as contract negotiations continue, though no walkout has been scheduled.
ne-20260914-bmc-nurses-strike-vote.text: boston medical center nurses vote to authorize strike nearly 90% of the hospital’s union-represented nurses backed a strike authorization as contract negotiations continue, though no walkout has been scheduled. nurses at boston medical center voted to authorize a strike, with nearly 90% of about 2,000 nurses represented by 1199seiu united healthcare workers east voting yes, wbur reported monday through the state house news service. the authorization gives the union leverage in negotiations but does not mean a strike will begin immediately. the union and hospital have been bargaining for more than six months. union representatives say their proposals seek stronger staffing, training and long-term commitments to address vacancies. the hospital has not announced a strike date, and the union has not issued the 10-day notice required before workers could walk out. the next bargaining session is scheduled for sept. 25. the vote comes after a separate nurses’ strike at boston children’s hospital and brigham and women’s hospital in july, but the bmc negotiations are a distinct labor dispute. any strike timing and effect on patient care would depend on future talks and required notice. massachusetts massachusetts massachusetts ma boston boston, massachusetts massachusetts boston medical center health care labor

ne-20260914-boston-flock-report.excerpt: A city review says a Flock Safety error briefly allowed outside agencies to access vehicle information collected during Boston’s camera pilot.
ne-20260914-boston-flock-report.text: boston report details flock data-sharing failure during police pilot a city review says a flock safety error briefly allowed outside agencies to access vehicle information collected during boston’s camera pilot. boston’s 2025 surveillance technology report says flock safety distributed data in a way that conflicted with promises made to the city, wbur reported monday. the boston police department’s pilot ran for 156 days, from april 1 through sept. 4, 2025, and used 45 license-plate and vehicle-recognition cameras at no cost. within three days of the pilot’s start, boston police learned that other agencies could access license-plate and vehicle information because of a flock configuration error. the city’s report does not establish which agencies accessed the information or how many drivers were affected. after the system was secured, boston police received 77 access requests from agencies including the state department, atf, dea and police departments in massachusetts and maine. the department and city said they will not continue using flock. the episode underscores the importance of access controls and clear data-sharing limits in public surveillance programs. massachusetts massachusetts massachusetts ma boston boston, massachusetts massachusetts boston policing surveillance privacy

ne-20260914-cornelis-ai-networking.excerpt: The AI infrastructure company says its new funding will support networking technology designed to help AI chips communicate more efficiently.
ne-20260914-cornelis-ai-networking.text: cornelis raises $205 million for ai chip networking technology the ai infrastructure company says its new funding will support networking technology designed to help ai chips communicate more efficiently. cornelis, an ai infrastructure company developing networking technology for ai chips, announced a $205 million funding round monday, techcrunch reported. the round was led by iag capital partners. cornelis is working on the connections between processors that power large ai systems. those links can affect how quickly data moves through a cluster and how efficiently companies can use expensive computing hardware. the company is positioning its technology as an alternative source of infrastructure as demand for ai servers grows. the financing adds to a broader push by startups to challenge established suppliers around the ai hardware stack, including networking, memory and specialized processors. the announcement does not mean cornelis will displace nvidia or other incumbents; it signals investor interest in the supporting technology needed to build and operate larger ai systems. tech tech tech santa clara, california tech artificial intelligence semiconductors networking funding

ne-20260914-dangote-refinery-ipo.excerpt: Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote launched an IPO for his oil refinery, targeting up to $2.1 billion to fund expansion in what Reuters calls Africa’s largest share sale.
ne-20260914-dangote-refinery-ipo.text: dangote launches africa’s largest ipo with oil refinery share sale nigerian billionaire aliko dangote launched an ipo for his oil refinery, targeting up to $2.1 billion to fund expansion in what reuters calls africa’s largest share sale. aliko dangote launched an initial public offering for his nigerian oil refinery monday, seeking up to $2.1 billion to fund expansion, reuters reported. the sale is expected to offer roughly a 3% stake, with retail investors able to seek as few as 10 shares at about $4, according to the report. a private placement in july valued the refinery at about $40 billion. the ipo implies a valuation closer to $49 billion, though the final result will depend on demand and pricing. the refinery currently has capacity of about 700,000 barrels per day and aims to reach 1.4 million barrels per day by 2029. the offering would be a major test for nigeria’s capital markets and for investor appetite for the country’s largest industrial project. the figures above are terms and targets reported for the offering, not a guarantee of the final valuation or proceeds. markets markets markets/stocks lagos, nigeria markets/stocks dangote nigeria ipo oil

ne-20260914-emmys-2026-preview.excerpt: The 78th Emmy Awards take place Monday night, with NBC’s drama winner ‘The Pitt’ and comedy contenders ‘Hacks’ and ‘Widow’s Bay’ among the evening’s main storylines.
ne-20260914-emmys-2026-preview.text: emmy awards arrive with ‘the pitt,’ ‘hacks’ and ‘widow’s bay’ in spotlight the 78th emmy awards take place monday night, with nbc’s drama winner ‘the pitt’ and comedy contenders ‘hacks’ and ‘widow’s bay’ among the evening’s main storylines. the 78th emmy awards are scheduled for monday night at the peacock theater, with mariska hargitay hosting on nbc and streaming coverage on peacock, the associated press reported. the ceremony is set for 8 p.m. eastern time. ‘the pitt’ enters the night as the defending drama winner. ‘widow’s bay’ already has eight wins from earlier ceremonies and could set a comedy record if it adds six more. ‘hacks,’ which is in its fifth and final season, leads the comedy field in nominations, with jean smart among the night’s expected focal points. the awards will add another chapter to a television season shaped by returning franchises, final-season campaigns and streaming competition. winners can change the balance among the leading shows, but the ap preview’s milestones are based on nominations and earlier wins rather than predictions of who will prevail. misc misc misc. los angeles, california misc. emmy awards television the pitt hacks

ne-20260914-epa-power-plant-rule.excerpt: The Environmental Protection Agency says it is eliminating rules that limit greenhouse-gas emissions from coal- and natural-gas-fired power plants.
ne-20260914-epa-power-plant-rule.text: epa moves to repeal power-plant greenhouse gas limits the environmental protection agency says it is eliminating rules that limit greenhouse-gas emissions from coal- and natural-gas-fired power plants. the environmental protection agency is moving to repeal federal rules limiting greenhouse-gas emissions from coal- and natural-gas-fired power plants, the associated press reported monday. the action would reverse a central part of the federal government’s recent effort to regulate climate pollution from the electricity sector. the epa says eliminating the rules would remove more than $300 billion in costs for the power industry and support energy reliability. the agency is also pursuing a separate step intended to prevent future administrations from regulating greenhouse-gas emissions from power plants under the same approach. the policy shift affects a major source of u.s. electricity and is likely to draw responses from states, utilities, environmental groups and industry representatives. the ap report described the epa’s announced actions and rationale; the legal and practical effects will depend on the final regulatory language and any ensuing court challenges. breaking breaking breaking/developing washington, d.c. breaking epa energy climate policy power plants

ne-20260914-kimball-castle-arrests.excerpt: New Hampshire authorities arrested two young men in connection with an incendiary fire that destroyed the historic Lakes Region property last year.
ne-20260914-kimball-castle-arrests.text: two arrested in fire that destroyed historic kimball castle in gilford new hampshire authorities arrested two young men in connection with an incendiary fire that destroyed the historic lakes region property last year. the new hampshire state fire marshal’s office arrested two men this month in connection with the august 2025 fire at kimball castle in gilford, according to indepthnh.org. the stone castle, a historic property overlooking lake winnipesaukee, was destroyed in what investigators classified as an incendiary fire. joshua d. pittman, 18, of dover, was arrested sept. 1 on a felony conspiracy-to-commit-arson charge and a misdemeanor criminal-trespass charge. peyton n. eastman, 19, of portsmouth, was arrested sept. 2 on a felony arson charge and misdemeanor trespass. the arrests followed the fire marshal’s investigation into the property’s destruction. both men were processed and released on personal recognizance, the report said. they are scheduled for arraignment oct. 8 at laconia district court. the charges are allegations, and the court process will determine the facts and any potential penalties. new-hampshire new-hampshire new hampshire nh gilford gilford, new hampshire new hampshire gilford arson courts lake winnipesaukee

ne-20260914-kimberly-clark-kenvue.excerpt: Kimberly-Clark is preparing possible asset sales to address European antitrust concerns over its proposed $40 billion acquisition of Kenvue, Reuters reports.
ne-20260914-kimberly-clark-kenvue.text: kimberly-clark prepares concessions to win approval for kenvue deal kimberly-clark is preparing possible asset sales to address european antitrust concerns over its proposed $40 billion acquisition of kenvue, reuters reports. kimberly-clark is preparing concessions aimed at winning european union approval for its proposed $40 billion acquisition of kenvue, people familiar with the matter told reuters monday. the eu is expected to communicate preliminary concerns this week, while its initial review is scheduled to end sept. 29. the companies could face a longer investigation if regulators conclude the deal could reduce competition in consumer health and personal-care products. kimberly-clark and kenvue have already received conditional clearance in australia and south africa, according to reuters. the possible remedies have not been finalized or publicly detailed. kimberly-clark shares rose more than 2.7% and kenvue shares gained 2.3% in early trading after the report, figures that describe that trading period rather than current prices. investors are watching whether asset sales or other commitments can address the eu’s concerns without changing the deal’s financial case. markets markets markets/stocks brussels, belgium markets/stocks kimberly-clark kenvue antitrust mergers

ne-20260914-morgan-morgan-ai-investment.excerpt: The personal-injury law firm says it plans to invest $1 billion in artificial intelligence and technology over the next decade, including expansion of its internal platform.
ne-20260914-morgan-morgan-ai-investment.text: morgan & morgan announces $1 billion ai investment plan the personal-injury law firm says it plans to invest $1 billion in artificial intelligence and technology over the next decade, including expansion of its internal platform. morgan & morgan plans to invest $1 billion in artificial intelligence and technology over the next decade, reuters reported monday. the firm has already spent about $300 million on mx2, an internal platform intended to support legal work, and says the system is used by nearly 5,000 people each month. the firm plans to offer mx2 to other law firms by late 2027. that would turn a tool built for internal operations into a commercial technology product, putting morgan & morgan into competition with legal-technology vendors as firms look for ways to automate research, intake and case management. the announcement reflects how ai spending is spreading beyond technology companies into professional services. the investment figure is a plan, not money already spent, and the firm’s proposed rollout remains subject to development and business decisions. reuters reported the company’s spending and timing statements; it did not establish that the platform’s use has produced specific financial or legal outcomes. tech tech tech united states tech artificial intelligence legal technology business

ne-20260914-providence-i95-rollover.excerpt: A passenger died and the driver remained critically injured after a single-car rollover on northbound I-95, Rhode Island State Police said.
ne-20260914-providence-i95-rollover.text: one dead, one critically injured after i-95 rollover in providence a passenger died and the driver remained critically injured after a single-car rollover on northbound i-95, rhode island state police said. one person was killed and another was critically injured after a single-car rollover on interstate 95 northbound in providence late saturday night, nbc 10 wjar reported. the crash occurred shortly before the branch avenue overpass at about 11:25 p.m. the driver and passenger were ejected from the vehicle, according to the report. the passenger died, while the driver was taken for treatment and was described as critical but stable. authorities had not released the identities of either person in the initial report. the crash remains under investigation. officials have not announced what caused the vehicle to leave the roadway or whether any charges will follow. drivers using the providence stretch of i-95 should expect investigations and emergency response to affect traffic when serious overnight crashes occur. rhode-island rhode-island rhode island ri providence providence, rhode island rhode island providence i-95 traffic safety

ne-20260914-sprint-doubles-budapest.text: jefferson-wooden and bednarek sweep sprint titles in budapest melissa jefferson-wooden and kenny bednarek each won the 100- and 200-meter races at the inaugural world athletics ultimate championship. melissa jefferson-wooden and kenny bednarek each completed a sprint double at the inaugural world athletics ultimate championship in budapest, reuters reported sunday. both athletes won the 100 meters and followed with victories in the 200 meters. jefferson-wooden ran 21.47 seconds in the 200, the third-fastest women’s time ever recorded, according to reuters. gabby thomas finished second in 21.77. bednarek won the men’s 200 in 19.52 after taking the 100 title earlier in the meet. the two champions each collected $300,000, making the event one of the richest prizes in track and field. the budapest meet is designed as a new showcase for elite athletes, and the sprint results gave it an immediate pair of headline performances without changing the established records credited to earlier races. misc misc misc. budapest, hungary misc. track and field budapest world athletics sports

ne-gulf-maine-herring-spawning-closure-2.text: gulf of maine herring spawning closures begin in western maine and mass.-n.h. waters the seasonal restrictions bar directed atlantic herring fishing in two inshore spawning areas through nov. 3, with a limited incidental-catch allowance for other fisheries. seasonal spawning closures for atlantic herring began wednesday in the western maine and massachusetts-new hampshire areas of the inshore gulf of maine, the atlantic states marine fisheries commission said. the closures run from 12:01 a.m. sept. 23 through 11:59 p.m. nov. 3. the massachusetts-new hampshire area includes waters bounded by the massachusetts, new hampshire and maine coasts, along with specified latitude and longitude lines used in the fishery management plan. vessels in the directed herring fishery cannot take, land or possess herring caught in either closed area during the restriction. boats operating in other fisheries may keep up to 2,000 pounds of incidental herring per trip per day, and vessels transiting the areas must have fishing gear stowed. the commission said insufficient biological samples were available to trigger its forecasting system, so the two areas moved to their default closure dates. eastern maine has a separate spawning closure that began aug. 28 and is scheduled to run through oct. 8. atlantic herring support marine food webs as a forage species and remain important to commercial and bait fisheries. the seasonal restrictions are intended to protect fish as they reach spawning condition. new-england new-england new england gulf of maine maine new hampshire massachusetts atlantic herring gulf of maine fisheries

nh-anne-edwards-access-justice-co-chair-.text: justice anne edwards named co-chair of new hampshire access commission the superior court associate justice will help lead the statewide panel that studies civil legal needs and barriers to the courts. new hampshire superior court associate justice anne edwards has been named co-chair of the state's access to justice commission, joining attorney mark rouvalis in leading the panel. the commission was created by the new hampshire supreme court to examine unmet civil legal needs, identify barriers to the court system and support initiatives that improve access. edwards joined the superior court in 2023 after nearly 27 years with the new hampshire department of justice. that background gives the commission a co-chair with experience across state government and the judiciary as it coordinates work among judges, lawyers and organizations that assist people who cannot easily obtain legal representation. the leadership change comes as the commission continues to assess practical obstacles that can determine whether residents are able to use the civil courts effectively. those challenges can include the cost of counsel, limited legal information and the complexity of court procedures. circuit court judge melissa countway will remain a commission member, preserving continuity as edwards takes on the co-chair role. new-hampshire new-hampshire new hampshire new hampshire concord concord, new hampshire anne edwards new hampshire courts access to justice commission civil law concord

nh-bone-conduction-headphones-hearing-ri.excerpt: The open-ear devices may improve awareness outdoors, but specialists say excessive volume still reaches and can injure the inner ear.
nh-bone-conduction-headphones-hearing-ri.text: nhpr explainer warns bone-conduction headphones can still damage hearing the open-ear devices may improve awareness outdoors, but specialists say excessive volume still reaches and can injure the inner ear. bone-conduction headphones can keep a listener aware of traffic and other surroundings, but they do not remove the risk of hearing damage, according to a new nhpr outside/in explainer. the devices transmit vibrations through the skull to the cochlea instead of sending sound through the outer ear. that open-ear design can be useful for runners, cyclists and others who need to hear what is happening nearby. the tradeoff is that loud playback still reaches the same sensitive structures in the inner ear. prolonged exposure at high volume can therefore cause the same kind of damage associated with conventional headphones. university of michigan noise-exposure researcher rick neitzel told the program that weak bass and background noise can lead users to raise the volume. in a loud setting, noise-canceling headphones may allow comfortable listening at a lower level because they reduce the competing sound rather than trying to overpower it. practical safeguards remain familiar: use phone volume limits and monitoring tools, take listening breaks, and move to a quieter place when possible. bone-conduction models may offer an awareness advantage outdoors, but the safer choice still depends on volume, duration and the surrounding noise—not simply on how audio reaches the ear. new-hampshire new-hampshire new hampshire new hampshire new hampshire hearing health bone-conduction headphones nhpr consumer technology

nh-claremont-september-11-stair-climb-20.text: claremont stair climb honors september 11 victims residents of many ages completed routes modeled on the world trade center’s 110 stories during the city’s 25th-anniversary remembrance. a crowd gathered at the claremont visitor center on friday for a memorial stair climb marking 25 years since the september 11 attacks. organized by claremont parks and recreation, the event gave participants a route designed to equal 110 stories, the height of each world trade center tower. the group ranged from children as young as 5 to people in their 80s, and some walkers brought dogs. two firefighters from nearby weathersfield climbed in full turnout gear. participants could choose their own distance and pace rather than complete the entire challenge, while the most demanding option called for 20 loops of 110 stairs in gear or a weighted vest. the event honored the nearly 3,000 people killed in the 2001 attacks, including hundreds of firefighters and other emergency personnel. fire chief jim chamberlin told the gathering that the community’s continued remembrance a quarter-century later was both humbling and a hopeful reflection of claremont. the climb combined a demanding physical tribute with an accessible community observance. new-hampshire new-hampshire new hampshire nh claremont claremont, new hampshire claremont september 11 memorial stair climb first responders community
